+version = "3.11.1"
+runner.dialect = scala3
+
+rewrite.scala3.convertToNewSyntax = true
+rewrite.scala3.removeOptionalBraces = true
+rewrite.rules = [RedundantBraces, SortModifiers, Imports]
+rewrite.sortModifiers.order = [
+  "final", "sealed", "abstract", "override", "implicit", "private", "protected", "lazy"
+]
+rewrite.imports.sort = scalastyle
+rewrite.imports.groups = [
+  ["java\\..*", "scala\\..*"],
+  [".*"]
+]
+
+maxColumn = 100
+indent.main = 2
+newlines.source = keep
+
+align.preset = more
+align.tokens."+" = [
+  {
+    code = "=",
+    owners = [
+      {regex = "Term\\.Apply"},
+      {regex = "Term\\.Assign"}
+    ]
+  }
+]
+align.stripMargin = true
+align.multiline = true

+# --- Assemble the eval-pipeline fat JAR --------------------------------------
+FROM eclipse-temurin:25-jdk-resolute AS builder
+
+COPY lib/sbt-2.0.1.tgz /tmp/sbt.tgz
+RUN tar -xz -C /usr/local -f /tmp/sbt.tgz && rm /tmp/sbt.tgz
+ENV PATH="/usr/local/sbt/bin:$PATH"
+
+WORKDIR /build
+COPY build.sbt ./
+COPY project/ ./project/
+RUN sbt update
+COPY src/ ./src/
+RUN sbt assembly && \
+    find target -name "eval-pipeline-assembly.jar" -print -quit | \
+    xargs -I{} cp {} /eval-pipeline-assembly.jar
+
+# --- Runtime image -----------------------------------------------------------
+FROM eclipse-temurin:25-jdk-resolute
+
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
+    unzip gnupg lsb-release gcc make \
+    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# --- Multi-version JDKs (temurin 8 / 11 / 17) --------------------------------
+COPY lib/adoptium-gpg.pub /tmp/adoptium-gpg.pub
+RUN cat /tmp/adoptium-gpg.pub \
+        | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/adoptium.gpg \
+    && rm /tmp/adoptium-gpg.pub \
+    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/adoptium.gpg] \
+        https://packages.adoptium.net/artifactory/deb $(lsb_release -cs) main" \
+        | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/adoptium.list \
+    && apt-get update \
+    && apt-get install -y temurin-8-jdk temurin-11-jdk temurin-17-jdk \
+    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+ENV JAVA_8_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-8-jdk-amd64
+ENV JAVA_11_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-11-jdk-amd64
+ENV JAVA_17_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-17-jdk-amd64
+
+# --- OpenTxl 11.3.7 ----------------------------------------------------------
+RUN --mount=type=bind,source=lib/opentxl-11.3.7-linux-x64.tar.gz,target=/tmp/opentxl.tar.gz \
+    mkdir /tmp/txl \
+    && tar -xz -C /tmp/txl --strip-components=1 -f /tmp/opentxl.tar.gz \
+    && cd /tmp/txl && sh InstallTxl.sh \
+    && rm -rf /tmp/txl
+
+# --- NiCad 7.0.1 --------------------------------------------------------------
+RUN --mount=type=bind,source=lib/nicad-7.0.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz,target=/tmp/nicad.tar.gz \
+    --mount=type=bind,source=conf/nicad/jnorm-txl,target=/tmp/jnorm-txl \
+    --mount=type=bind,source=src/main/scala/onorm/txl,target=/tmp/onorm-txl \
+    mkdir /tmp/nicad \
+    && tar -xz -C /tmp/nicad --strip-components=1 -f /tmp/nicad.tar.gz \
+    && cp /tmp/jnorm-txl/* /tmp/nicad/lib/nicad/txl/ \
+    && cp /tmp/onorm-txl/* /tmp/nicad/lib/nicad/txl/ \
+    && cd /tmp/nicad/lib/nicad/txl \
+    && for f in jimple*.txl tac*.txl; do txlc -s 400 "$f"; done \
+    && cd /tmp/nicad && sh InstallNicad.sh \
+    && rm -rf /tmp/nicad
+COPY conf/nicad/nicad-consistent.cfg /usr/local/lib/nicad/config/nicad-consistent.cfg
+COPY conf/nicad/nicad-blind.cfg      /usr/local/lib/nicad/config/nicad-blind.cfg
+COPY conf/nicad/nicad-none.cfg       /usr/local/lib/nicad/config/nicad-none.cfg
+
+# --- BigCloneEval (Commit: 6d393ec) --------------------------------------------
+COPY external/bigcloneeval /app/external/bigcloneeval
+RUN cd /app/external/bigcloneeval && make
+
+# --- JNorm (Soot) --------------------------------------------------------------
+COPY lib/jnorm-cli.jar /app/lib/jnorm-cli.jar
+
+# --- JNorm (SootUp 2.0.0) ------------------------------------------------------
+COPY lib/jnorm-sootup-cli-2.0.0.jar /app/lib/jnorm-sootup-cli-2.0.0.jar
+
+# --- Pipeline ------------------------------------------------------------------
+RUN mkdir -p /app/data /app/work /app/results
+COPY --from=builder /eval-pipeline-assembly.jar /app/lib/pipeline.jar
+COPY scripts/check-txl-parsing.sh      /app/scripts/check-txl-parsing.sh
+COPY scripts/collect-txl-parsing-failures.sh /app/scripts/collect-txl-parsing-failures.sh
+
+ENV APP_ROOT=/app
+ENV PIPELINE_XMX=8g
+WORKDIR /app
+ENTRYPOINT ["sh", "-c", "exec java --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED --sun-misc-unsafe-memory-access=allow \"-Xmx${PIPELINE_XMX}\" -jar /app/lib/pipeline.jar \"$@\"", "--"]
+CMD []

@@ -0,0 +1,223 @@
+# onorm-artifact
+
+[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.22060241.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22060241)
+
+**Title:** ONorm: OPAL-Based Java Bytecode Normalization for Code Clone Detection Across JDK Versions  
+**Author:** Luka Weinberg  
+**Artifact:** Reproduction package (v1.0.0 - 22 August 2026)  
+**DOI:** [10.5281/zenodo.22060241](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22060241)
+
+The artifact contains ONorm, an OPAL-based Java bytecode normalizer producing TAC IR in standard and aggressive modes,
+and an evaluation pipeline measuring BigCloneBench recall. The pipeline evaluates ONorm and JNorm (Soot/SootUp), each in
+standard and aggressive modes, against a source-code baseline across all NiCad renaming strategies (consistent, blind,
+none). For IR tools, evaluation additionally spans class files compiled with Java 8, 11, and 17 as well as a
+cross-version target (round-robin across compiler versions).
+
+## Research Questions
+
+- **RQ1** How does ONorm compare with JNorm in clone detection recall on BigCloneBench across standard and aggressive normalization modes?
+- **RQ2** How does clone detection recall on BigCloneBench vary across JDK versions 8, 11, and 17 under Java bytecode normalization?
+- **RQ3** How does clone detection recall on BigCloneBench differ between Java bytecode normalization and direct source-code analysis?
+
+## Directory Structure
+
+```
+conf/        NiCad configuration and Jimple IR TXL grammars
+data/        Pipeline input data
+external/    BigCloneEval evaluation tool
+lib/         Pipeline dependencies
+results/     Evaluation results
+scripts/     Utility, diagnostic and reproducibility scripts
+src/         Pipeline and ONorm source code
+work/        Intermediate pipeline outputs
+```
+
+## Hardware and Configuration
+
+The full run was executed inside a Docker container on an Intel Core Ultra 7 265K (16 of 20 cores), 48 GB DDR5 RAM
+6000 MT/s (of 64 GB), a Samsung 9100 Pro 2 TB NVMe SSD, and 20 GB JVM heap space. On Windows 11 Pro, Docker was run via
+WSL2 to improve I/O performance. The full run requires at least 600 GB of free disk space under Windows 11 Pro with
+WSL2. Requirements on other
+operating systems may differ. The full run completed in 35h 29m 12s.
+
+The default JVM heap is 8 GB. Adjust `PIPELINE_XMX` in `docker-compose.yml` (Option A) or via `-e PIPELINE_XMX=20g` in
+the `docker run` command (Option B) to match available memory before running:
+
+```yaml
+# Option A -- docker-compose.yml
+environment:
+  PIPELINE_XMX: "20g"
+```
+
+```bash
+# Option B -- docker run flag
+-e PIPELINE_XMX=20g
+```
+
+If NiCad fails, reduce `MAX_NICAD_FILES` in `src/main/scala/core/Constants.scala` (default: 10_000) and rebuild the
+image. This requires the full source code (Option A only).
+
+## Scripts
+
+`download-lib.sh` (Option A only) and `download-data.sh` populate `lib/` and `data/` respectively and are required
+before the first run (see Option A and B below). All downloaded files are verified against SHA-256 checksums to ensure
+integrity.
+
+`check-txl-parsing.sh` reports OK and FAIL counts per IR variant for all JNorm, ONorm, and source files. All FAIL counts
+should be 0 since all files are expected to be parseable. Run inside a Docker container after the pipeline has
+completed:
+
+```bash
+# Option A
+docker compose run --rm --entrypoint sh pipeline /app/scripts/check-txl-parsing.sh
+
+# Option B
+docker run --rm -v ./work:/app/work --entrypoint sh onorm-artifact:v1.0.0 /app/scripts/check-txl-parsing.sh
+```
+
+`collect-txl-parsing-failures.sh` writes detailed TXL error output and file content for each failing file to
+`work/txl-parsing-failures/`. Use when `check-txl-parsing.sh` reports non-zero FAIL counts:
+
+```bash
+# Option A
+docker compose run --rm --entrypoint sh pipeline /app/scripts/collect-txl-parsing-failures.sh
+
+# Option B
+docker run --rm -v ./work:/app/work --entrypoint sh onorm-artifact:v1.0.0 /app/scripts/collect-txl-parsing-failures.sh
+```
+
+`sweep-nicad-minsize.sh` sweeps NiCad `minsize` over 6, 10, 15, and 20 (using functionality IDs 6, 10, 11, 12) to
+empirically confirm that `minsize=10` yields higher precision at equal recall compared to the NiCad default of
+`minsize=6`. Requires an image tagged `onorm-artifact:v1.0.0` to already exist locally, either via `docker compose
+build` (Option A) or `docker load` (Option B), since `docker-compose.yml` expects that exact image name. Runs from
+the host:
+
+```bash
+./scripts/sweep-nicad-minsize.sh
+```
+
+To preserve an existing full run, run this from a separate directory containing copies of `conf/`,
+`scripts/sweep-nicad-minsize.sh`, `docker-compose.yml`, a populated `data/`, and empty `work/`/`results/`.
+
+## Running the Pipeline
+
+All execution is done inside Docker. `data/` must be populated before running (Option A also requires `lib/`). The
+directories `data/` (read-only), `work/`, and `results/` are volume-mounted from the host and persist between runs. All
+pipeline steps implement output caching and produce fully reproducible outputs — a fixed random seed (42) is used
+throughout. An interrupted run can be resumed by rerunning the same command.
+
+Parameters:
+
+- `--func-ids <IDs>`: valid IDs are 2-15,17-45
+- `--force`: flag, no value needed
+
+### Option A: From Source
+
+Requires Docker with Compose, `curl`, and `sha256sum`.
+
+```bash
+# Optional -- lib/ is already included. Use download-lib.sh only to verify checksums or re-download
+./scripts/download-lib.sh
+
+# Download pipeline input data into data/
+./scripts/download-data.sh
+
+# Build the Docker image
+docker compose build
+
+# Full run -- all 43 BigCloneBench functionalities
+docker compose run --rm pipeline
+
+# Partial run -- specific functionality IDs
+docker compose run --rm pipeline --func-ids 6,10,11,12
+
+# Force full run -- use when switching from a partial to a full run. Archives previous results and clears work/
+docker compose run --rm pipeline --force
+
+# Force partial run -- use when switching between different --func-ids sets. Archives previous results and clears work/
+docker compose run --rm pipeline --func-ids 6,10,11,12 --force
+
+# Alternatively, work/ and results/ can be cleared manually (without archiving previous results)
+```
+
+### Option B: Pre-built Image (Zenodo)
+
+Requires Docker, `curl`, and `sha256sum`. No source code or build step needed for this option. The Zenodo record
+archives the full source code alongside:
+- pre-built Docker image: `onorm-artifact.tar`
+- data/ : `bcb.h2.db.zip`, `StubFiles.zip`, `IJaDataset_BCEvalVersion.tar.gz`
+- lib/ : `adoptium-gpg.pub`, `jnorm-cli.jar`, `jnorm-sootup-cli-2.0.0.jar`, `nicad-7.0.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, `opentxl-11.3.7-linux-x64.tar.gz`, `sbt-2.0.1.tgz`
+- results/ : `eval/`, `log/` (results from the full run)
+
+```bash
+# Place the three data files downloaded from the Zenodo record into data/
+
+# Optional -- verify their checksums using download-data.sh (skips the download since the files already exist)
+./scripts/download-data.sh
+
+# Load the pre-built image
+docker load -i onorm-artifact.tar
+
+# If using the image from the GHCR package instead, retag it to match:
+# docker tag ghcr.io/lukawnb/onorm-artifact:v1.0.0 onorm-artifact:v1.0.0
+
+# Full run -- all 43 BigCloneBench functionalities
+docker run --rm \
+  -v ./data:/app/data:ro \
+  -v ./work:/app/work \
+  -v ./results:/app/results \
+  -e PIPELINE_XMX=8g \
+  --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \
+  onorm-artifact:v1.0.0
+
+# Partial run -- specific functionality IDs
+docker run --rm \
+  -v ./data:/app/data:ro \
+  -v ./work:/app/work \
+  -v ./results:/app/results \
+  -e PIPELINE_XMX=8g \
+  --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \
+  onorm-artifact:v1.0.0 \
+  --func-ids 6,10,11,12
+
+# Force full run -- use when switching from a partial to a full run. Archives previous results and clears work/
+docker run --rm \
+  -v ./data:/app/data:ro \
+  -v ./work:/app/work \
+  -v ./results:/app/results \
+  -e PIPELINE_XMX=8g \
+  --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \
+  onorm-artifact:v1.0.0 \
+  --force
+
+# Force partial run -- use when switching between different --func-ids sets. Archives previous results and clears work/
+docker run --rm \
+  -v ./data:/app/data:ro \
+  -v ./work:/app/work \
+  -v ./results:/app/results \
+  -e PIPELINE_XMX=8g \
+  --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \
+  onorm-artifact:v1.0.0 \
+  --func-ids 6,10,11,12 --force
+
+# Alternatively, work/ and results/ can be cleared manually (without archiving previous results)
+```
+

+name := "onorm-artifact"
+idePackagePrefix := Some("io.github.lukawnb")
+version := "0.1.0-SNAPSHOT"
+
+ThisBuild / scalaVersion := "3.8.4"
+
+val osLibVersion        = "0.11.8"
+val upickleVersion      = "4.4.3"
+val mainargsVersion     = "0.7.8"
+val scalaXMLVersion     = "2.4.0"
+val opalVersion         = "7.0.0"
+val zstdJniVersion      = "1.5.7-11"
+val logbackVersion      = "1.5.35"
+val scalaLoggingVersion = "3.9.6"
+
+libraryDependencies ++= Seq(
+  // File-/Processmanagement
+  "com.lihaoyi" %% "os-lib" % osLibVersion,
+
+  // JSON
+  "com.lihaoyi" %% "upickle" % upickleVersion,
+
+  // CLI-Parser
+  "com.lihaoyi" %% "mainargs" % mainargsVersion,
+
+  // XML Parser
+  "org.scala-lang.modules" %% "scala-xml" % scalaXMLVersion,
+
+  // Compression
+  "com.github.luben" % "zstd-jni" % zstdJniVersion,
+
+  // H2 1.3.176 pinned: BCB database is H2 1.x format, incompatible with H2 2.x
+  "com.h2database" % "h2" % "1.3.176",
+
+  // OPAL
+  "de.opal-project" %% "common" % opalVersion,
+  "de.opal-project" %% "bytecode-infrastructure" % opalVersion,
+  "de.opal-project" %% "bytecode-representation" % opalVersion,
+  "de.opal-project" %% "abstract-interpretation-framework" % opalVersion,
+  "de.opal-project" %% "three-address-code" % opalVersion,
+
+  // Logging
+  "ch.qos.logback" % "logback-classic" % logbackVersion,
+  "com.typesafe.scala-logging" %% "scala-logging" % scalaLoggingVersion
+)
+
+assembly / mainClass    := Some("io.github.lukawnb.cli.Main")
+assembly / assemblyJarName := "eval-pipeline-assembly.jar"
+
+
+assembly / assemblyMergeStrategy := {
+  case PathList("META-INF", "services", _*) => MergeStrategy.concat
+  case PathList("META-INF", _*)          => MergeStrategy.discard
+
+  case x if x.endsWith("reference.conf") => MergeStrategy.concat
+  case x if x.endsWith("application.conf") => MergeStrategy.concat
+
+  case _ => MergeStrategy.first
+}
+
+javacOptions ++= Seq("--release", "25")
+scalacOptions ++= Seq(
+  "-java-output-version", "25",
+  "-new-syntax",
+  "-indent",
+  "-feature",
+  "-deprecation",
+  "-language:strictEquality",
+  "-Wunused:all",
+  "-Wvalue-discard",
+  "-Werror"
+)
+
+Global / excludeLintKeys += idePackagePrefix

+% TXL BOM handling plugin
+% A. Malton & J.R. Cordy, April 2011
+
+% Revised July 2020
+
+% DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE.
+% Your editor may convert it and destroy the critical characters
+% in the token pattern.
+
+% Include this file in your TXL program using the command
+%    include "bom.grm"
+% to ignore UTF-8 BOM headers in input files, which otherwise can 
+% cause parsing problems.
+
+tokens

+% NiCad generic consistent renaming for potential clones
+% Jim Cordy, May 2010
+
+% Rev 19.5.20 JRC - Added literal renaming 
+
+define source_unit  
+    [xml_source_coordinate]
+        [potential_clone]		% supplied by language plugin
+    [end_xml_source_coordinate]
+end define
+
+redefine program
+    [repeat source_unit]
+end redefine
+
+% Main program
+
+rule main
+    skipping [source_unit]
+    replace $ [source_unit]
+	BeginXML [xml_source_coordinate]
+	    PC [potential_clone]
+	EndXML [end_xml_source_coordinate]
+    by
+	BeginXML 
+	    PC [renameIds]
+               [renameLiterals]		% supplied by language plugin
+	EndXML 
+end rule
+
+% Rule to normalize using consistent renaming of identifiers
+% to normal form (x1, x2, x3, ...)
+
+function renameIds
+    replace [potential_clone]
+        PC [potential_clone]
+
+    % Make a list of all of the unique identifiers 
+    construct Ids [repeat id]
+        _ [^ PC] [removeDuplicateIds]
+
+    % Make normalized new names of the form xN for each of them
+    construct GenIds [repeat id]
+        Ids [genIds 0]
+
+    % Consistently replace each instance of each one by its normalized form
+    by
+        PC [$ each Ids GenIds]
+end function
+
+% Utility rule - remove duplicate ids from a list
+
+function removeDuplicateIds
+    replace [repeat id]
+        Id [id] 
+	Rest [repeat id]
+    by
+	Id
+        Rest [removeIds Id]
+	     [removeDuplicateIds]
+end function
+
+rule removeIds Id [id]
+    replace [repeat id]
+        Id
+	More [repeat id]
+    by
+        More
+end rule
+
+% Utility rule - make a normalized id of the form xN for each unique id in a list
+
+function genIds NM1 [number]
+    % For each id in the list
+    replace [repeat id]
+        _ [id] 
+        Rest [repeat id] 
+
+    % Generate the next xN id
+    construct N [number]
+        NM1 [+ 1]
+    construct GenId [id]
+        _ [+ 'x] [+ N]
+
+    % Replace the id with the generated one
+    % and recursively do the next one
+    by
+        GenId 
+        Rest [genIds N]
+end function
+

+% NiCad function extractor, Java
+% Jim Cordy, January 2008
+
+% Revised Oct 2020 - new source file name protocol - JRC
+% Revised July 2018 - update to match new Java 8 grammar - JRC
+% Revised Nov 2012 - remove @Override annotations from clone comparison - JRC
+% Revised Aug 2012 - disallow ouput forms in input parse - JRC
+% Revised July 2011 - ignore BOM headers in source
+% Revised 25.03.11 - match constructors as methods - JRC
+% Revised 30.04.08 - unmark embedded functions - JRC
+
+% NiCad tag grammar
+include "nicad.grm"
+
+% Using Java 8 grammar
+include "jimple.grm"
+
+% Ignore BOM headers from Windows
+include "bom.grm"
+
+% Redefinitions to collect source coordinates for function definitions as parsed input,
+% and to allow for XML markup of function definitions as output
+
+% Modified to match constructors as well.  Even though the grammar still
+% has constructor_declaration in it, this one will match first. - JRC 25mar11
+
+redefine method_declaration
+	[repeat annotation]			% Remove @Override annotations from clone comparison
+	[method_definition]
+    |  
+    	[method_header]
+    	[opt annotation_default] ';               [NL][NL]
+end redefine
+
+define method_definition
+	% Input form 
+	[srclinenumber] 			% Keep track of starting file and line number
+	[method_header]
+	'{                                        [NL][IN] 
+	    [method_contents]			  [EX]
+	    [srclinenumber] 			% Keep track of ending file and line number
+	'}
+    |
+	% Output form 
+	[not token]				% disallow output form in input parse
+	[opt xml_source_coordinate]
+	[method_header]
+	'{                                        [NL][IN] 
+	    [method_contents]			  [EX]
+	'}
+	[opt end_xml_source_coordinate]
+end define
+
+define method_header
+	[repeat modifier] [opt generic_parameter] [opt type_specifier] [method_declarator] [opt throws] 
+end define
+
+define method_contents
+	[repeat declaration_or_statement]     
+	[opt expression_statement_no_semi]
+end define
+
+define annotation_default
+	'default [annotation_value]
+end define
+
+redefine program
+	...
+    | 	[repeat method_definition]
+end redefine
+
+
+% Main function - extract and mark up function definitions from parsed input program
+function main
+    replace [program]
+	P [program]
+    construct Functions [repeat method_definition]
+    	_ [^ P] 			% Extract all functions from program
+	  [convertFunctionDefinitions] 	% Mark up with XML
+    by 
+    	Functions [removeOptSemis]
+	          [removeEmptyStatements]
+end function
+
+rule convertFunctionDefinitions
+    import TXLargs [repeat stringlit]
+	FileNameString [stringlit]
+
+    % Find each function definition and match its input source coordinates
+    replace [method_definition]
+	LineNumber [srclinenumber]
+	FunctionHeader [method_header]
+	'{
+	    FunctionBody [method_contents]
+	    EndLineNumber [srclinenumber]
+	'}
+
+    % Convert line numbers to strings for XML
+    construct LineNumberString [stringlit]
+	_ [quote LineNumber] 
+    construct EndLineNumberString [stringlit]
+	_ [quote EndLineNumber] 
+
+    % Output is XML form with attributes indicating input source coordinates
+    construct XmlHeader [xml_source_coordinate]
+	'<source file=FileNameString startline=LineNumberString endline=EndLineNumberString>
+    by
+	XmlHeader
+	FunctionHeader 
+	'{
+	    FunctionBody [unmarkEmbeddedFunctionDefinitions] 
+	'}
+	'</source>
+end rule
+
+rule unmarkEmbeddedFunctionDefinitions
+    replace [method_definition]
+	LineNumber [srclinenumber]
+	FunctionHeader [method_header]
+	'{
+	    FunctionBody [method_contents]
+	    EndLineNumber [srclinenumber]
+	'}
+    by
+	FunctionHeader 
+	'{
+	    FunctionBody 
+	'}
+end rule
+
+rule removeOptSemis
+    replace [opt ';]
+	';
+    by
+	% none
+end rule
+
+rule removeEmptyStatements
+    replace [repeat declaration_or_statement]
+	';
+	More [repeat declaration_or_statement]
+    by
+	More
+end rule

+% NiCad literal renaming for Java
+% Jim Cordy, May 2020
+
+rule renameLiterals
+    replace $ [literal]
+        L [literal]
+    by
+        L [renameNumericLiterals]
+%          [renameCharLiterals]
+          [renameStringLiterals]
+end rule
+
+function renameNumericLiterals
+    replace [literal]
+        N [numeric_literal]
+    by
+        '1
+end function
+
+%function renameCharLiterals
+%    replace [literal]
+%        C [character_literal]
+%    by
+%        ''x'
+%end function
+
+function renameStringLiterals
+    replace [literal]
+        S [string_literal]
+    by
+        '"x"
+end function

+% Originally based on the Java Language Specification, 2nd edition, 2001,
+% and updated to 3rd Edition, 2007
+
+% Modification Log:
+
+% v4.2, Jim Cordy, October 2020.
+%   Corrected formatting of class bodies, for loops.

+% v4.1, Jim Cordy, August 2018.
+%   Corrected cast expression to allow for lambda expressions.
+

+%   Updated to Java 8.

+%   Added optional class body to enums.
+%   Added default modifier.
+%   Updated with resourced try statement.
+%   Updated with multiple catch type specifiers.
+%   Added lambda expressions.
+%   Added method references.
+%   Corrected error in [conditional_expression].
+%   Added optional [expression_statement_no_semi] at end of [block].
+%   Validated against Qualitas Java corpus (44,817 files), 
+%        Java8InAction examples (100 files, covering all of Java 8), 
+%        GitHub random corpus of 1,000 Java projects (117,430 files).
+
+% v3.8, Jim Cordy, February 2018.
+%   Corrected label_name to [id].
+
+% v3.7, Jim Cordy, November 2015.
+%   Removed enum from keyword list.  In Java, enum is not reserved and may be used as an identifier.
+

+

+%   Tuning to improve parsing by specializing type components from reference compoenents
+
+% v3.4, Jim Cordy, June 2010.
+%   Minor fixes to annotations, reference components
+
+% v3.3, Krellner/Reichel (Chemnitz University of Technology, Germany), September/November 2008.
+%   New complex but JLS conform number token definition.
+%   Token definition for both DOS and UNIX newline usage.
+%   Fixed grammar resulted syntax errors.
+%   Allowed method calls appended to a new class or array creation.
+%   Modified class instance creations of nested/inner classes.
+%   Allowed default array annotation.
+%   Fixed logic error in class_instance_creation_expression.
+
+% v3.2, Jim Cordy, October 2008.
+%   Corrected method and constructor declarations to allow for generic parameters.
+
+% v3.1, Jim Cordy, May 2008.
+%   Validated on a range of open source Java software including JHotDraw 5.4b1,
+%   Eclipse-Ant, Eclipse-JDTcore, Java2 SDK 1.4.0-Swing, Netbeans-Javadoc and Spule.
+%   Updated to address slight problems.
+
+% v3.0, Tom Dean, October 2007.
+% -- updated to Java 5
+% -- added assert statement (Java 1.4)
+% -- added '$' to id character set
+% -- added for/in statement (Java 5)
+% -- added var arg modifier for method parametrs (Java 5)
+% -- added keyword static to imports(Java 5)
+% -- added enumerated types (Java 5)
+% -- fixed label_statement (java 1.2)
+% -- added annotations (Java 5)
+% -- previous versions of the grammar conflated declared_name and
+%    reference because javap inserted the package name as part of the
+%    class name when analyzing libraries. With generics this becomes
+%    too ambiguous. declared_name and refernce now have separate
+%    definitions. To handle javap output, redefine declared name
+%    as:
+%        redefine declared_name
+%            [repeat pkg_class_prefix] [id] [opt generic_parameter]
+%        end redefine
+%    where pkg_class_prfix is defined as "[id] '."
+% -- removed >>, >>>, >>= and >>>= from compounds and inserted [SPOFF] [SPON]
+%    where they occur in the grammar. Conflicts with nested Genearics
+%    such as List<List<Integer>>
+% -- added generic and type wildcards (Java 5)
+%
+% -- TODO:
+%      * Unicode. Java supposedly is Unicode in Java 5. Not exactly
+%         sure what it means for TXL.
+%      * String escape codes including \u for unicode
+
+% v2.0-2.3, Xinping Guo, July 2002.
+%  -- Added 'strictfp in defintion of modifier.
+%  -- Added [repeat component] after "( [expression] ') in defintion of primary.
+%  -- Redefined "primary". Removed "primary_component" and "dot_primary_component"
+%  -- Redefined "subprimary".
+%  -- Removed "field_access", "method_invocation" and "constructor_invocation".
+%  -- Redefined "reference".
+%  -- Defined "component".
+%  -- Defined "method_argument".
+%  -- Defined a new nonterminal type called "declared_name".
+%  -- "class_name", "interface_name", "variable_name" and "method_name" are "declared_name".
+%  -- Changed "reference" to "variable_name" in "catch_clause".
+%  -- In "constructor_declarator", changed "type_name" to "class_name".
+%  -- In "implements_clause", changed "class_name+" to "qualified_name+".
+%  -- Defined a new nonterminal type called "method_or_constructor_declaration".
+%  -- In "member_declaration", removed "field_declaration" and changed  
+%         "method_declaration" to "method_or_constructor_declaration".
+%  -- In "class_body_declaration", removed "constructor_declaration" and
+%         added "field_declaration".
+
+% v1.0, Jim Cordy, fall 2001.  
+
+
+% Lexical conventions of Java 
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007, added "$"
+#pragma -width 4096 -id "$"
+
+tokens
+    id      "[$\u][$\i]*" 
+        |   "'[[$\u][$\i]]*'"
+    parameter "parameter\d+(_\d+)*"  % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOT] allow jNorm _N suffix (e.g. parameter1_1)
+    % JC 1 May 2018 - added _ digit to all forms 
+    number  "\d[\d_]*[lL]?"  % DecimalIntegerLiteral | OctalIntegerLiteral
+          | "\d[\d_]*.[\d_]*([eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*)?[fFdD]?"  % DecimalFloatingPointLiteral
+          | ".\d[\d_]*([eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*)?[fFdD]?"  % DecimalFloatingPointLiteral (cont.'d)
+          | "\d[\d_]*[eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*[fFdD]?"  % DecimalFloatingPointLiteral (cont.'d)
+          | "\d[\d_]*([eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*)?[fFdD]"  % DecimalFloatingPointLiteral (cont.'d)
+          | "0[xX][\dabcdefABCDEF][\d_abcdefABCDEF]*.[pP][+-]?\d[\d_]*[fFdD]?"  % HexadecimalFloatingPointLiteral
+          | "0[xX][\d_abcdefABCDEF]*.[\dabcdefABCDEF][\d_abcdefABCDEF]*[pP][+-]?\d[\d_]*[fFdD]?"  % HexadecimalFloatingPointLiteral (cont.'d)
+          | "0[xX][\dabcdefABCDEF][\d_abcdefABCDEF]*([pP][+-]?\d+)?[lLfFdD]?"  % HexIntegerLiteral | HexadecimalFloatingPointLiteral (cont.'d)
+end tokens
+
+comments
+    //
+    /*  */
+end comments
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007 added ...
+compounds
+    !=  '%=  &&  &=  *=  ++  +=   --  -=  /=  ^=  |=  ||
+    <<  <<=  <=  ==  >=   ...
+end compounds
+
+
+% Removed this and super - XG June 19, 2002
+% added assert and enum - TD Oct 2007
+% removed cast, inner, they cannot be keywords - JRC Apr 08
+% removed enum, cannot be keyword - JRC Nov 15
+keys
+    'abstract 'assert 'boolean 'break 'byte
+    'case 'catch 'char 'class 'const 'continue
+    'default 'do 'double 'else 'extends
+    'false 'final 'finally 'float 'for
+    'goto 'if 'implements 'import
+    'instanceof 'int 'interface 'long
+    'native 'new 'null 'package 'private 'protected 'public 'return
+    'short 'static 'strictfp 'switch 'synchronized
+    'throw 'throws 'transient 'true 'try 'void 'volatile 'while 
+    'strictfp 'enum 'null_type 'breakpoint
+    % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] 'annotation removed from keys: SootUp uses it as package segment in java.lang.annotation.Annotation; still matched as [id] and via 'annotation literal in modifier/interface_header
+    % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] 'unknown removed from keys: SootUp uses it as enum constant/field name; still matched via 'unknown literal in primitive_type_or_id
+    'cmp 'cmpg 'cmpl 'entermonitor 'exitmonitor 'interfaceinvoke
+    'lengthof 'lookupswitch 'neg 'newarray 'newmultiarray 'nop
+    'ret 'specialinvoke 'staticinvoke 'dynamicinvoke 'tableswitch
+    'from 'to 'with 'cls
+    'super  % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp emits ACC_SUPER flag as 'super before 'class in class declarations
+    'varargs  % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] ACC_VARARGS method flag; SootUp emits 'switch instead of lookupswitch/tableswitch ('switch already in keys)
+end keys
+
+
+% Syntax of Java 1.5 
+
+define program
+    [package_declaration]
+end define
+
+
+% Declarations
+
+define package_declaration
+    [opt package_header]
+    [repeat import_declaration] 
+    [repeat type_declaration]
+end define
+
+define package_header
+    [repeat annotation]        	% T.D. Oct 2007
+    'package [package_name] '; [NL][NL]
+end define
+
+define package_name
+    [qualified_name]
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007 added static import
+define import_declaration
+        'import [opt 'static] [imported_name] '; [NL][NL]
+    |         '; [NL] 	% JRC Apr 08
+end define
+
+define imported_name
+    [package_or_type_name] [opt dot_star]
+end define
+
+define package_or_type_name
+    [qualified_name]
+end define
+
+define dot_star
+    '. '*
+end define
+
+define declared_name
+   [id] [opt generic_parameter] | [id] '. [declared_name]
+ | [stringlit]  % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp double-quotes identifiers that are SootUp-internal keywords (e.g. "from", "to", "phi" as enum constant names)
+end define
+
+% Class and interface declarations
+
+define type_declaration
+        [class_declaration]      [NL][NL]
+    |   [interface_declaration]  [NL][NL]
+%    |   [enum_declaration]         [NL]		% T.D. Oct 2007
+end define
+
+define class_declaration
+    [class_header] [class_body]
+end define
+
+define class_header
+    [repeat modifier] 'class [class_name] [opt extends_clause] [opt implements_clause]
+end define
+
+define class_body
+    [class_or_interface_body]
+end define
+
+define interface_declaration
+    [interface_header] [interface_body]
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007 -- added annotation marker
+define interface_header
+    [repeat modifier] [opt annot_marker] 'interface [opt 'annotation] [interface_name] [opt extends_clause] [opt implements_clause]  % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp emits 'interface annotation Foo' for Java @interface types; Soot used '@interface Foo'
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007
+define annot_marker
+   '@
+end define
+
+define interface_body
+    [class_or_interface_body]
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007
+define enum_declaration
+    [enum_header] [enum_body]
+end define
+
+define enum_header
+    [repeat modifier] [opt id] 'enum [opt declared_name] [opt implements_clause]
+end define
+
+define enum_body
+    '{                                    [IN]
+       [list enum_element] [opt ',]
+       [repeat class_body_declaration]    [EX]
+    '} [opt ';]                           [NL][NL]
+end define
+
+define enum_element
+        				  [NL]
+        [repeat modifier] [id] [opt method_argument] 
+        [opt class_or_interface_body]	% JC May 2018
+end define
+
+define modifier
+        'abstract
+    |   'final
+    |   'public
+    |   'protected
+    |   'private
+    |   'static
+    |   'transient
+    |   'volatile
+    |   'native
+    |   'synchronized
+    |   'strictfp        	% Added strictfp XG July 23, 2002
+    |   [annotation]        	% T.D. Oct 2007
+    |        'default	% JC 1 May 2018
+    |   'enum
+    |   'annotation
+    |   'super              % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] ACC_SUPER class flag; Soot omits it, SootUp writes it explicitly
+    |   'varargs            % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] ACC_VARARGS method flag; SootUp writes it as a method modifier
+end define
+
+define extends_clause
+    'extends [list type_name+]
+end define
+
+define implements_clause
+    'implements [list qualified_name+]
+end define
+
+define class_name
+    [declared_name]
+end define
+
+define interface_name
+    [declared_name]
+end define
+
+define class_or_interface_body
+    '{                                    [NL][IN]
+       [repeat class_body_declaration]    [NL][EX]
+    '} [opt ';]                           [NL]
+end define
+
+define class_body_declaration
+        [empty_declaration]
+    |   [member_declaration]
+    |   [instance_initializer]
+    |   [static_initializer]
+    |   [field_declaration] 
+end define
+
+define empty_declaration
+    '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define member_declaration
+       [method_or_constructor_declaration]
+    |  [type_declaration]     % [class_declaration] or [interface_declaration]
+end define
+
+define method_or_constructor_declaration
+        [method_declaration]
+    |   [constructor_declaration]
+end define
+
+define instance_initializer
+    [NL] [block]             [NL][NL]
+end define
+
+define static_initializer
+    [NL] 'static [block]     [NL][NL]
+end define
+
+% to match Java Code like:
+% public <T> void someMethod(T t) {
+%        // ...
+% }
+define constructor_declaration
+    [NL] [repeat modifier] [opt generic_parameter] [type_specifier] [constructor_declarator] [opt throws] [constructor_body] [NL][NL]
+end define
+
+define constructor_declarator
+    '<init> '( [list formal_parameter] ')
+end define
+
+define constructor_body
+    [block] [NL]
+end define
+
+
+% Field declarations 
+
+define field_declaration
+    [variable_declaration] [NL]
+end define
+
+define variable_declaration
+    [repeat modifier] [type_specifier] [variable_declarators] '; 
+end define
+
+define variable_declarators
+    [list variable_declarator+]
+end define
+
+define variable_declarator
+    [variable_name] [opt equals_variable_initializer]
+end define
+
+define variable_name
+    [declared_name][repeat dimension]
+end define
+
+define equals_variable_initializer
+    '= [variable_initializer]
+end define
+
+define variable_initializer
+        [expression]
+    |   [array_initializer]
+end define
+
+define array_initializer
+    '{ [list variable_initializer] [opt ',] '}
+end define
+
+
+% Method declarations 
+
+% generic method declaration (to match generic types used only in a method's declaration and body)
+define method_declaration
+    [NL] [repeat modifier] [opt generic_parameter] [type_specifier] [method_declarator] [opt throws] [method_body]
+end define
+
+define method_declarator
+    [method_name] '( [list formal_parameter] ') [repeat dimension]    
+end define
+
+define method_name
+    [declared_name] | '<init> | '<clinit>
+    | [parameter]  % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOT] allow jNorm parameter-token as field/method name (e.g. parameter1_1)
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007 added var_arg
+define formal_parameter
+    [repeat variable_modifier] [type_specifier] [opt var_arg_specifier] %[opt formal_parameter_name]
+end define
+
+define variable_modifier
+        'final
+    |        [annotation]
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007
+define var_arg_specifier
+        '...		% can only be applied to last parameter of method
+end define
+
+define formal_parameter_name
+    [variable_name]
+end define
+
+define throws
+    'throws [list qualified_name+]
+end define
+
+define method_body
+        [block]  [NL][NL]
+    |        ';       [NL][NL]
+    |   'default [annotation_value] ';  [NL][NL]
+end define
+
+% Type specifiers
+
+define type_specifier
+    [type_name] [repeat dimension] 
+end define
+
+define array_type_specifier
+    [type_name] [repeat dimension+]
+end define
+
+define type_name
+            [primitive_type_or_id] [repeat type_component]
+end define
+
+define primitive_type_or_id
+        [primitive_type]
+    |        [id]
+    |        'null_type  % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOT] Soot emits null_type as type specifier
+    |        'unknown    % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOT] Soot emits unknown as type specifier
+    |        'null       % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp uses null as formal parameter type in method signatures
+end define
+
+define type_component
+     [dot_id]
+   | [generic_argument]                           % T.D. Nov 2007
+end define
+
+define primitive_type
+        'boolean
+    |   'char
+    |   'byte
+    |   'short
+    |   'int
+    |   'long
+    |   'float
+    |   'double
+    |   'void
+end define
+
+% Annotations - T.D. Oct 2007
+
+define annotation
+   [SPOFF] '@ [type_name] [opt '@] [SPON] [opt annotation_value_spec]        	[NL]
+end define
+
+define annotation_value_spec
+   '( [annotation_value_list] ')
+end define
+
+define annotation_value_list
+      [annotation_value]
+    | [list keyed_annotation_value]
+end define
+
+define annotation_value
+      [expression]
+    | [nested_annotation]
+    | { [list expression_or_nested_annotation] [opt ',] }
+end define
+
+define nested_annotation
+    [annotation]
+end define
+
+define expression_or_nested_annotation
+      [expression]
+    | [nested_annotation]
+end define
+
+define keyed_annotation_value
+    [id] '= [annotation_value]
+end define
+
+% Statements
+
+define block
+    '{                                        [NL][IN] 
+        [repeat declaration_or_statement]     
+        [opt expression_statement_no_semi]    [EX]
+    '}
+end define
+
+define declaration_or_statement
+        [declaration]
+    |        [class_declaration] 
+    |   [statement]
+end define
+
+define declaration
+    [local_variable_declaration]  [NL]
+end define
+
+define local_variable_declaration
+    [variable_declaration]
+end define
+
+define statement
+        [label_statement]        
+    |   [empty_statement]
+    |   [expression_statement]
+    |   [if_statement]
+    |   [lookupswitch_statement]
+    |   [tableswitch_statement]
+    |   [while_statement]
+    |   [do_statement]
+    |   [for_statement]
+    |   [for_in_statement]        	% T.D. Oct 2007
+    |   [break_statement]
+    |   [continue_statement]
+    |   [return_statement]
+    |   [throw_statement]
+    |   [synchronized_statement]
+    |   [try_statement]
+    |   [assert_statement]        	% T.D. Oct 2007
+    |   [block_statement]
+
+    |   [identity_statement]
+    |   [invoke_statement]
+    |   [goto_statement]
+    |   [entermonitor_statement]
+    |   [exitmonitor_statement]
+    |   [catch_def]
+    |   [switch_statement]     % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp plain switch
+    |   [nop_statement]        % [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp standalone nop
+end define
+
+define block_statement
+        [block] 	   [NL]
+end define
+
+define empty_statement
+    ';                     [NL]
+end define
+
+define label_statement
+    [label_name] ': %[statement]        	% T.D. Oct 2007 -- label applies to a given statement
+            				% -- more than one label may be applied to a statement
+end define
+
+define label_name
+    [id]
+end define
+
+define expression_statement
+    [expression] ';        [NL]
+end define
+
+define expression_statement_no_semi
+    [expression]           [NL]
+end define
+
+define if_statement
+    'if  [condition] 'goto  [label_name]     
+end define
+
+define else_clause
+    'else
+        [statement]
+end define
+
+define lookupswitch_statement
+    'lookupswitch '( [expression] ') [switch_block]  [NL]
+end define
+
+define tableswitch_statement
+    'tableswitch '( [expression] ') [switch_block]  [NL]
+end define
+
+% [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp unifies lookupswitch/tableswitch as plain switch; trailing ';' is optional
+define switch_statement
+    'switch '( [expression] ') [switch_block] [opt ';]  [NL]
+end define
+
+define switch_block
+    '{                                         [IN][NL]
+        [repeat switch_alternative]            [EX]
+    '} 
+end define
+
+define switch_alternative
+    [switch_label]                             [IN][NL]
+        [repeat declaration_or_statement]      [EX]
+end define
+
+define switch_label
+        'case [constant_expression] ':  
+    |   'default ':
+end define
+
+define while_statement
+    'while '( [condition] ') 
+        [statement]
+end define
+
+define do_statement
+    'do
+        [statement]
+    'while '( [condition] ') ';                [NL]
+end define
+
+define for_statement
+    'for '( [for_init] [for_expression] [for_update] ')
+        [statement]
+end define
+
+define for_init
+        [list expression] ';    
+    |   [local_variable_declaration]
+end define
+
+define for_expression
+    [opt expression] ';    
+end define
+
+define for_update
+    [list expression]
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007
+define for_in_statement        
+    'for '( [for_in_init] : [expression] ')
+        [statement]
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007
+define for_in_init
+        [repeat modifier] [type_specifier] [variable_name]
+end define
+
+define break_statement
+    'break [opt label_name] ';       [NL]
+end define
+
+define continue_statement
+    'continue [opt label_name] ';    [NL]
+end define
+
+define return_statement
+    'return [opt expression] ';      [NL]
+end define
+
+define throw_statement
+    'throw [expression] ';           [NL]
+end define
+
+define synchronized_statement
+    'synchronized '( [expression] ')
+        [statement]
+end define
+
+define try_statement
+    'try [resource_specification?] [block] [repeat catch_clause] [opt finally_clause]    [NL]
+end define
+
+% begin JC 1 May 2018
+define resource_specification
+    '( [resource_list] [opt ';] ')
+end define
+
+define resource_list
+        [resource] [semi_resource*] 
+end define
+
+define resource
+        [repeat variable_modifier] [type_specifier] [variable_name] '= [expression]
+end define
+
+define semi_resource
+        '; [resource]
+end define
+
+% end JC 1 May 2018
+
+define catch_clause
+%    'catch '( [type_specifier] [reference] ') [block] 
+%    'catch '( [repeat modifier] [catch_type_specifier] [variable_name] ') [block]  % July 15
+[empty]
+end define
+
+% begin JC 1 May 2018
+define catch_type_specifier
+        [type_specifier] [or_type_specifier*]
+end define
+
+define or_type_specifier
+        '| [type_specifier]
+end define
+% end JC 1 May 2018
+
+define finally_clause
+    'finally [block] 
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007
+define assert_statement
+    'assert [expression] [opt assert_error_code]';        	[NL]
+end define
+
+% T.D. Oct 2007
+define assert_error_code
+        ': [expression]
+end define
+
+% Expressions
+
+define constant_expression
+    [expression]    % which is a constant
+end define
+
+define expression
+        [lambda_expression]	% JC 1 May 2018
+    |   [assignment_expression]
+    |   [invoke_expr]
+end define
+
+define condition
+    [expression]
+end define
+
+% begin JC 1 May 2018
+compounds
+    ->
+end compounds
+
+define lambda_expression
+        [lambda_parameters] '-> [lambda_body]
+end define
+
+define lambda_parameters
+        [id]
+    |        '( [list lambda_parameter] ')
+end define
+
+define lambda_parameter
+        [formal_parameter]
+    |        [inferred_formal_parameter]
+end define
+
+define inferred_formal_parameter
+        [id]
+end define
+
+define lambda_body
+        [expression]
+    |        [block]
+end define
+% end JC 1 May 2018
+
+define assignment_expression
+        [conditional_expression]
+    |   [unary_expression] [assignment_operator] [expression]   
+end define
+
+define assignment_operator
+        '=
+    |   '*=
+    |   '/=
+    |   '%=
+    |   '+=
+    |   '-=
+    |   '<<=
+    |   [SPOFF] '> '>= [SPON]
+    |   [SPOFF] '> '> '>= [SPON]
+    |   '&=
+    |   '^=
+    |   '|=
+end define
+
+define conditional_expression
+    [conditional_or_expression] [repeat conditional_choice]
+end define
+
+define conditional_choice
+    '? [expression] ': [conditional_expression]
+end define
+
+define conditional_or_expression
+    [conditional_and_expression] [repeat or_conditional_and_expression]
+end define
+
+define or_conditional_and_expression
+    '|| [conditional_and_expression]
+end define
+
+define conditional_and_expression
+    [inclusive_or_expression] [repeat and_inclusive_or_expression]
+end define
+
+define and_inclusive_or_expression
+    '&& [inclusive_or_expression]
+end define
+
+define inclusive_or_expression
+    [exclusive_or_expression] [repeat or_exclusive_or_expression]
+end define
+
+define or_exclusive_or_expression
+    '| [exclusive_or_expression]
+end define
+
+define exclusive_or_expression
+    [and_expression] [repeat or_and_expression]
+end define
+
+define or_and_expression
+    '^ [and_expression]
+end define
+
+define and_expression
+    [equality_expression] [repeat and_equality_expression]
+end define
+
+define and_equality_expression
+    '& [equality_expression]
+end define
+
+define equality_expression
+    [relational_expression] [repeat equality_op_relational_expression]
+end define
+
+define equality_op_relational_expression
+    [equality_op] [relational_expression]
+end define
+
+define equality_op
+    '== | '!=
+end define
+
+define relational_expression
+    [shift_expression] [repeat relational_op_shift_expression]
+end define
+
+define relational_op_shift_expression
+        [relational_op] [shift_expression]
+    |   'instanceof [type_specifier]
+end define
+
+define relational_op
+    '<  | '> | '<= | '>= | 'cmp | 'cmpl | 'cmpg
+end define
+
+define shift_expression
+    [additive_expression] [repeat shift_additive_expression]
+end define
+
+define shift_additive_expression
+    [shift_op] [additive_expression]
+end define
+
+define shift_op
+    '<< | [SPOFF] '> '> [SPON] | [SPOFF] '> '> '>  [SPON]
+end define
+
+define additive_expression
+    [multiplicative_expression] [repeat add_op_multiplicative_expression]
+end define
+
+define add_op_multiplicative_expression
+    [add_op] [multiplicative_expression]
+end define
+
+define add_op
+    '+ | '- 
+end define
+
+define multiplicative_expression
+    [unary_expression] [repeat mult_op_unary_expression]
+end define
+
+define mult_op_unary_expression
+    [mult_op] [unary_expression]
+end define
+
+define mult_op
+    '* | '/ | '% 
+end define
+
+define unary_expression
+        [pre_inc_dec] [unary_expression]
+    |   [unary_op] [unary_expression]
+    |   [postfix_expression]
+    |   [cast_expression]
+end define
+
+define pre_inc_dec
+    '++ | '--
+end define
+
+define unary_op
+    '+ | '- | '~ | '! | 'lengthof | 'neg
+end define
+
+define cast_expression
+        '( [type_specifier] ') [unary_expression]
+    |        '( [type_specifier] ') [lambda_expression]
+end define
+
+define postfix_expression
+    [primary] [repeat post_inc_dec]
+end define
+
+define post_inc_dec
+    '++ | '--
+end define
+
+define subscript
+    '[ [expression] ']        
+end define
+
+% to match Java Code like:
+% // ...
+% int i = new String[]{"", ""}.length;
+% String s = new Object() { public void toString() { return "Hello World"; } }.toString();
+define primary
+        [literal] [repeat component]
+    |   [reference]
+    |   '( [expression] ') [repeat component]
+    |   [class_instance_creation_expression] [repeat component]
+    |   [array_creation_expression] [repeat component]
+end define
+
+define literal
+        [numeric_literal]
+    |   [character_literal]
+    |   [string_literal]
+    |   [boolean_literal]
+    |   [null_literal]
+    |   'class [string_literal]
+end define
+
+define numeric_literal
+    [number] | '#NaN | '#-Infinity | '#Infinity | '#NaNF | '#-InfinityF | '#InfinityF | '#NaNf | '#-Infinityf | '#Infinityf
+end define
+
+define character_literal
+    [charlit]
+end define
+
+define string_literal
+    [stringlit]
+end define
+
+define boolean_literal
+        'true
+    |   'false
+end define
+
+define null_literal
+    'null
+end define
+
+% Sample problem:
+% /* ... */ new SomeClass().someMethod();
+% Was just derived to "SomeClass().someMethod"
+define class_instance_creation_expression
+    'new [class_or_interface_name] '( [list argument] ') [opt class_body]
+    |   'new [class_or_interface_name]
+end define
+
+define class_or_interface_name
+    [id] [repeat class_or_interface_component]
+end define
+
+% new
+define class_or_interface_component        % to match e.g. new java.util.HashSet<String>()
+        [dot_id]
+    |   [generic_argument]
+end define
+
+define array_creation_expression
+    'new [array_type_specifier] [opt array_initializer]
+    |   'newarray '( [type_specifier] ') [dimension]
+    |   'newmultiarray '( [type_specifier] ') [repeat dimension+]
+end define
+
+define dimension
+    '[ [opt expression] ']
+end define
+
+define argument
+        [expression]
+    |         [type_specifier]
+end define
+
+define qualified_name
+    [reference]
+end define
+
+define reference
+        [id] [repeat component]
+    |        [primitive_type] [repeat component]
+    |   [local] '. '< [class_name] ': [type_specifier] [method_name] '>
+    |   '< [class_name] ': [type_specifier] [method_name] '>
+end define
+
+% to match an instance creation of an inner class:
+% /* ... */ new OuterClass().new InnerClass();
+define component
+     [dot_id]
+   | [method_argument]
+   | [subscript] 
+   | [generic_argument]                           % T.D. Nov 2007
+   | [class_instance_creation_expression]  % JRC 8.6.10
+   | [dimension]        		   % JRC 9.6.10
+   | [method_reference]  % JC 1 May 2018
+end define
+
+compounds
+    ::
+end compounds
+
+% JC 1 May 2018
+define method_reference
+             ':: [generic_argument?] [id]
+     |        ':: 'new
+end define
+
+define class_instance_declaration
+     [class_instance_creation_expression]
+   | 'class
+end define
+
+define method_argument
+   '( [list argument] ')   
+end define
+
+define dot_id
+        '. [opt generic_argument] [id]	   % JRC 8.6.10
+    |   '. 'class
+    |   '. [class_instance_declaration]
+end define
+
+% T.D. generics. We have separated declared_name and reference
+% mostly to keep this part of the grammar simple
+
+define generic_argument
+    '< [list type_argument] '>
+end define
+
+define type_argument
+      [type_specifier]
+    | [wildcard_type]
+end define
+
+define wildcard_type
+      '? [opt wildcard_type_bound]
+    | [id] [opt wildcard_type_bound] % JRC 26.10.08
+end define
+
+define wildcard_type_bound
+      'extends [type_specifier]
+      | 'super [type_specifier]
+end define
+
+define generic_parameter
+    < [list type_parameter] >
+end define
+
+define type_parameter
+    [declared_name] [opt type_bound_clause]
+end define
+
+define type_bound_clause
+    'extends [type_bound]
+end define
+
+define type_bound
+    [type_specifier] [repeat and_type_spec]
+end define
+
+define and_type_spec
+    '& [type_specifier]
+end define
+
+define identity_statement
+    [local] ':= [at_identifier] [opt type_specifier] ';
+end define
+
+define goto_statement
+    'goto [label_name] ';
+end define
+
+% [PATCH-JNORM-SOOTUP] SootUp emits standalone 'nop ;' statements (nop was already a key but had no statement rule)
+define nop_statement
+    'nop ';  [NL]
+end define
+
+define local
+    [id]
+end define
+
+define immediate
+    [local] | [literal]
+end define
+
+define at_identifier
+        '@ [parameter] ':
+    |   '@ 'this ':
+    |   '@ 'caughtexception
+end define
+
+define full_identifier
+    [id] | [id] '. [full_identifier]
+end define
+
+define invoke_statement
+    [invoke_expr] ';
+end define
+
+define invoke_expr
+        [nonstatic_invoke] [local] '. [method_signature] '( [list argument] ')
+    |   'staticinvoke [method_signature] '( [list argument] ')
+    |   'dynamicinvoke [string_literal] [unnamed_method_signature] '( [list argument] ') [method_signature] '( [list argument] ')
+end define
+
+define nonstatic_invoke
+        'specialinvoke
+    |   'virtualinvoke
+    |   'interfaceinvoke
+end define
+
+define method_signature
+    '< [class_name] ': [type_specifier] [method_name] '( [list formal_parameter] ') '>
+end define 
+
+define unnamed_method_signature
+    '< [type_specifier] '( [list formal_parameter] ') '>
+end define
+
+define catch_def
+    'catch [class_name] 'from [label_name] 'to [label_name] 'with [label_name] ';
+end define
+
+define entermonitor_statement
+    'entermonitor [immediate] ';
+end define
+
+define exitmonitor_statement
+    'exitmonitor [immediate] ';
+end define
\ No newline at end of file

+% Version 4.2, October 2020

+

+
+% TXL Java 8 Grammar
+include "jimple.grm"
+

+include "bom.grm"
+

+function main
+    replace [program]

+    by

+end function

+% Generic grammar for NiCad XML tags
+% Jim Cordy, July 2020
+
+% We use special tokens to prevent language grammars from mistaking NiCad tags as language elements
+tokens
+    sourcetag	  "<source "	% includes space for precision
+    endsourcetag  "</source>"
+end tokens
+
+define xml_source_coordinate
+    [sourcetag] [SPOFF] 'file=[stringlit] [SP] 'startline=[stringlit] [SP] 'endline=[stringlit] '> [SPON] [NL]
+end define
+
+define end_xml_source_coordinate
+    [NL] [endsourcetag] [NL]
+end define

+# BigCloneEval: Evaluating Clone Detection Tools with BigCloneBench
+
+BigCloneEval is a framework for performing clone detection tool evaluation experiments
+with the BigCloneBench clone benchmark.
+
+## Table of Contents
+
+  * [Contact Information](#contact-information)
+  * [Installation and Setup](#installation-and-setup)
+     * [Step 1: Get the latest version of BigCloneEval](#step-1-get-the-latest-version-of-bigcloneeval)
+     * [Step 2: Get the latest version of BigCloneBench](#step-2-get-the-latest-version-of-bigclonebench)
+     * [Step 3: Get the latest version of IJaDataset](#step-3-get-the-latest-version-of-ijadataset)
+     * [Step 4: Build the source code.](#step-4-build-the-source-code)
+     * [Step 5: Initialize the tools database](#step-5-initialize-the-tools-database)
+  * [Using BigCloneEval](#using-bigcloneeval)
+     * [Experimental Process](#experimental-process)
+     * [Commands Summary](#commands-summary)
+     * [Step 1: Register Tool](#step-1-register-tool)
+     * [Step 2: Clone Detection](#step-2-clone-detection)
+     * [Step 3: Import Clones](#step-3-import-clones)
+     * [Step 4: Execute evaluation](#step-4-execute-evaluation)
+  * [Command Documentation](#command-documentation)
+     * [init](#init)
+     * [registerTool](#registertool)
