+              case StmtPatch.Concat(parts) => renderConcat(parts, tacMethod.tac.stmts(i))
+        rawOpt.foreach: raw =>
+          val processed = postProcess(raw, tacMethod, forward)
+          if processed.nonEmpty then buf += (i -> processed)
+        i += 1
+      buf.toIndexedSeq
+
+    // JNorm's UBF removes "unnecessary goto statements" (Schott et al.):
+    // a goto whose target is the immediately next surviving statement is a no-op.
+    val cleanRendered = rendered.zipWithIndex
+      .filterNot:
+        case ((_, text), pos) =>
+          text.startsWith("goto label") &&
+          text.stripPrefix("goto label").toIntOption
+            .exists(t => pos + 1 < rendered.length && rendered(pos + 1)._1 == t)
+      .map(_._1)
+
+    val referenced =
+      cleanRendered.iterator.flatMap((_, t) =>
+        LabelRef.findAllMatchIn(t).map(_.group(1).toInt)
+      ).toSet
+
+    val lines = cleanRendered.flatMap: (idx, text) =>
+      val label = Option.when(referenced.contains(idx))(s"label$idx:")
+      label.toSeq :+ s"$text;"
+
+    s"""$header
+       |{
+       |${lines.mkString("\n")}
+       |}
+       |""".stripMargin
+
+  private def postProcess(raw: String, tacMethod: TacMethod, forward: Int => Int): String =
+    val step1 = SingleDefLv.replaceAllIn(
+      raw,
+      m =>
+        val hex = m.group(1)
+        val d = Integer.parseInt(hex, 16)
+        val out = resolveSingleDef(d, tacMethod) match
+          case Some(text) => text
+          case None       => s"{lv$hex}" // leave for step 2 to collapse
+        Regex.quoteReplacement(out)
+    )
+    val step2 = collapseMultiDef(step1)
+    val step3 = PrivateMethodInvocationFilter(step2)
+    val step4 = step3.replaceAll("""/\*.*?\*/""", "")
+    // (?=\() distinguishes bootstrap calls from lambda proxy names like
+    // Foo$bar()Ljava$lang$String::172$Lambda where $Lambda precedes the arg list
+    val step5 = step4
+      .replaceAll("""\([^)]*\)[A-Z\[][^(:]*:+\d+(?=\()""", "")
+      .replaceAll("""\(\)([A-Z\[])""", "__$1")
+      .replaceAll("""::(\d)""", "__$1")
+    val step6 = GotoTarget.replaceAllIn(step5, m => s"goto label${forward(m.group(1).toInt)}")
+    val step7 = escapeControlCharsInStrings(step6)
+    step7.replaceAll("""\s+""", " ").trim
+
+  // linear scan to avoid regex StackOverflow on phi nodes with many def sites
+  private def collapseMultiDef(s: String): String =
+    val sb = new java.lang.StringBuilder(s.length)
+    var i = 0
+    while i < s.length do
+      val c = s.charAt(i)
+      if c == '{' then
+        val close = s.indexOf('}', i + 1)
+        if close > i then
+          val inner = s.substring(i + 1, close)
+          val first = inner.indexOf(',') match
+            case -1  => inner.trim
+            case idx => inner.substring(0, idx).trim
+          if first.startsWith("lv") || first.startsWith("param") || first.startsWith("exception")
+          then
+            sb.append(first)
+            i = close + 1
+          else
+            sb.append(c)
+            i += 1
+        else
+          sb.append(c)
+          i += 1
+      else
+        sb.append(c)
+        i += 1
+    sb.toString
+
+  private def resolveSingleDef(defSite: Int, tacMethod: TacMethod): Option[String] =
+    var d = defSite
+    var seen = Set.empty[Int]
+    while !seen.contains(d) do
+      seen += d
+      if d < 0 then return Some(s"param${(-d - 1).toHexString}")
+      tacMethod.resolved.get(StmtIndex(d)) match
+        case Some(RValue.Const(text)) => return Some(text)
+        case Some(RValue.Alias(d2))   => d = d2
+        case None                     => return None
+    None
+
+  private def accessModifiersText(method: Method): String =
+    Seq(
+      Option.when(method.isPublic)("public"),
+      Option.when(method.isProtected)("protected"),
+      Option.when(method.isPrivate)("private"),
+      Option.when(method.isStatic)("static"),
+      Option.when(method.isFinal)("final"),
+      Option.when(method.isSynchronized)("synchronized")
+    ).flatten.mkString(" ")
+
+  private def renderConcat(
+      parts: Seq[ConcatPart],
+      original: Stmt[DUVar[ValueInformation]]
+  ): String =
+    val args = parts.map:
+      case ConcatPart.Literal(text)          => quoteLiteral(text)
+      case ConcatPart.Arg(StringConst(_, s)) => quoteLiteral(s)
+      case ConcatPart.Arg(expr)              => ToTxt.toTxtExpr(expr)
+    val call = s"concat(${args.mkString(", ")})"
+    original match
+      case Assignment(_, dvar, _) => s"${dvar.name} = $call"
+      case _                      => call
+
+  private def quoteLiteral(s: String): String =
+    val sb = new java.lang.StringBuilder(s.length + 4)
+    sb.append('"')
+    s.foreach:
+      case '\\'                          => sb.append("\\\\")
+      case '"'                           => sb.append("\\\"")
+      case '\n'                          => sb.append("\\n")
+      case '\r'                          => sb.append("\\r")
+      case '\t'                          => sb.append("\\t")
+      case c if c < ' ' || c == '\u007f' => sb.append("\\u%04x".format(c.toInt))
+      case c                             => sb.append(c)
+    sb.append('"')
+    sb.toString
+
+  private def escapeControlCharsInStrings(s: String): String =
+    if !s.exists(c => c < ' ' || c == '\u007f') then return s
+    val sb = new java.lang.StringBuilder(s.length)
+    var i = 0
+    while i < s.length do
+      val c = s.charAt(i)
+      if c != '"' then
+        sb.append(c)
+        i += 1
+      else
+        sb.append('"')
+        i += 1
+        var inStr = true
+        while i < s.length && inStr do
+          val sc = s.charAt(i)
+          if sc == '\\' then
+            sb.append('\\')
+            i += 1
+            if i < s.length then
+              sb.append(s.charAt(i))
+              i += 1
+          else if sc == '"' then
+            sb.append('"')
+            i += 1
+            inStr = false
+          else if sc == '\n' then
+            sb.append("\\n")
+            i += 1
+          else if sc == '\r' then
+            sb.append("\\r")
+            i += 1
+          else if sc == '\t' then
+            sb.append("\\t")
+            i += 1
+          else if sc < ' ' || sc == '\u007f' then
+            sb.append("\\u%04x".format(sc.toInt))
+            i += 1
+          else
+            sb.append(sc)
+            i += 1
+    sb.toString
+
+  private def fixStringConsts(raw: String, stmt: Stmt[DUVar[ValueInformation]]): String =
+    val fixes = mutable.ArrayBuffer.empty[(String, String)]
+    def walk(expr: Expr[DUVar[ValueInformation]]): Unit =
+      expr match
+        case StringConst(_, v) if v.contains('"') || v.exists(_ < ' ') =>
+          fixes += ("\"" + v.replace("\\", "\\\\") + "\"") -> quoteLiteral(v)
+        case _                                                         =>
+          var i = 0
+          while i < expr.subExprCount do
+            walk(expr.subExpr(i))
+            i += 1
+    stmt.forallSubExpressions: e =>
+      walk(e)
+      true
+    if fixes.isEmpty then raw
+    else
+      fixes.foldLeft(raw):
+        case (s, (from, to)) => s.replace(from, to)

+% NiCad function extractor, TAC
+
+include "nicad.grm"
+include "tac.grm"
+
+% Redefine method_definition with input form (srclinenumber brackets) and
+% output form (XML source coordinate tags).
+redefine method_definition
+      % Input form -- srclinenumber recorded at open and close brace
+      [srclinenumber]
+      [method_header]
+      '{                        [NL][IN]
+          [method_contents]     [EX]
+          [srclinenumber]
+      '}
+    |
+      % Output form -- disallowed during input parse
+      [not token]
+      [opt xml_source_coordinate]
+      [method_header]
+      '{                        [NL][IN]
+          [method_contents]     [EX]
+      '}
+      [opt end_xml_source_coordinate]
+end redefine
+
+function main
+    replace [program]
+        P [program]
+    construct Functions [repeat method_definition]
+        _ [^ P]
+          [convertMethodDefinitions]
+    by
+        Functions
+end function
+
+rule convertMethodDefinitions
+    import TXLargs [repeat stringlit]
+        FileNameString [stringlit]
+
+    replace [method_definition]
+        LineNumber [srclinenumber]
+        Header [method_header]
+        '{
+            Body [method_contents]
+            EndLineNumber [srclinenumber]
+        '}
+
+    construct LineNumberString [stringlit]
+        _ [quote LineNumber]
+    construct EndLineNumberString [stringlit]
+        _ [quote EndLineNumber]
+    construct XmlHeader [xml_source_coordinate]
+        '<source file=FileNameString startline=LineNumberString endline=EndLineNumberString>
+    by
+        XmlHeader
+        Header
+        '{
+            Body
+        '}
+        '</source>
+end rule
\ No newline at end of file

+% TXL TAC Grammar
+% Method-level code clone detection -- no class wrapper, bare method list.
+
+#pragma -width 4096
+#pragma -id "$"
+
+tokens
+    id      "[$\u][$\i]*"
+          | "exception\[VM\]@\d+"
+          | "exception@\d+"
+    number  "\d[\d_]*[lL]?"
+          | "\d[\d_]*.\d*([eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*)?[fFdD]?"
+          | ".\d[\d_]*([eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*)?[fFdD]?"
+          | "\d[\d_]*[eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*[fFdD]?"
+          | "\d[\d_]*([eE][+-]?\d[\d_]*)?[fFdD]"
+          | "0[xX][\dabcdefABCDEF][\dabcdefABCDEF_]*[lL]?"
+          | "\#NaN" | "\#-Infinity" | "\#Infinity"
+end tokens
+
+comments
+    //
+    /* */
+end comments
+
+compounds
+    != == <= >= << >> >>> && || ++ -- += -= *= /=
+end compounds
+
+keys
+    'public 'protected 'private 'static 'final 'abstract
+    'synchronized 'native 'strictfp
+    'void 'boolean 'byte 'char 'short 'int 'long 'float 'double
+    'return 'new 'if 'goto 'throw 'switch 'caught
+    'null 'true 'false 'instanceof 'concat 'cmp 'cmpl 'cmpg
+    'default
+    'monitorenter 'monitorexit
+end keys
+
+% --- Top-level: bare sequence of methods -------------------------------------
+
+define program
+    [repeat method_definition]
+end define
+
+define method_definition
+    [method_header] '{ [NL] [IN]
+        [method_contents]
+    [EX] '} [NL]
+end define
+
+define method_header
+    [repeat modifier] [type_specifier] [method_name] '( [list formal_parameter] ')
+end define
+
+define method_contents
+    [repeat tac_stmt]
+end define
+
+% --- Modifiers, types, names -------------------------------------------------
+
+define modifier
+    'public | 'protected | 'private | 'static | 'final
+    | 'abstract | 'synchronized | 'native | 'strictfp
+end define
+
+define method_name
+    [id] | '< 'init '> | '< 'clinit '>
+end define
+
+define type_specifier
+    [primitive_type] [repeat dimension]
+    | [id] [repeat dot_id] [repeat dimension]
+end define
+
+define primitive_type
+    'void | 'boolean | 'byte | 'char | 'short | 'int | 'long | 'float | 'double
+end define
+
+define formal_parameter
+    [type_specifier]
+end define
+
+define dot_id
+    '. [id]
+end define
+
+define dimension
+    '[ ']
+end define
+
+% --- Statements --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+define tac_stmt
+      [label_stmt]
+    | [switch_stmt]
+    | [throw_stmt]
+    | [return_stmt]
+    | [if_goto_stmt]
+    | [goto_stmt]
+    | [caught_stmt]
+    | [monitor_stmt]
+    | [assign_stmt]
+    | [expr_stmt]
+end define
+
+define monitor_stmt
+    'monitorenter [tac_expr] '; [NL]
+  | 'monitorexit [tac_expr] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define label_stmt
+    [id] ': [NL]
+end define
+
+define switch_stmt
+    'switch '( [tac_expr] ') '{ [NL] [IN]
+        [repeat switch_case]
+        'default ': 'goto [tac_label]
+    [EX] '} '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define switch_case
+    [opt '-] [number] ': 'goto [tac_label] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define throw_stmt
+    'throw [tac_expr] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define return_stmt
+    'return [opt tac_expr] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define if_goto_stmt
+    'if '( [tac_expr] ') 'goto [tac_label] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define goto_stmt
+    'goto [tac_label] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+% Goto/switch targets: TacRenderer emits label<N> ids for normal forward/backward
+% branches, but OPAL switch-case targets can be raw negative integers (e.g. -1).
+define tac_label
+    [id] | [number] | '- [number]
+end define
+
+define caught_stmt
+    'caught '< 'ANY '> '; [NL]
+  | 'caught [type_specifier] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define assign_stmt
+    [tac_lvalue] '= [tac_expr] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+define tac_lvalue
+      [id] [repeat dot_id]
+    | [id] '[ [tac_expr] ']
+end define
+
+define expr_stmt
+    [tac_expr] '; [NL]
+end define
+
+% --- Expressions -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+define tac_expr
+    [tac_base_expr] [opt tac_infix_rhs]
+end define
+
+define tac_infix_rhs
+      [infix_op] [tac_base_expr]
+    | 'instanceof [type_specifier]
+end define
+
+define infix_op
+    '+ | '- | '* | '/ | '% | '& | '| | '^
+    | '== | '!= | '< | '> | '<= | '>= | '<< | '>> | '>>> | '&& | '||
+    | 'cmp | 'cmpl | 'cmpg
+end define
+
+% cast_expr tried before tac_unary so that (Type) expr is not parsed as
+% a parenthesised expression followed by an identifier.
+define tac_base_expr
+      [cast_expr]
+    | [tac_unary]
+end define
+
+define cast_expr
+    '( [cast_type] ') [tac_primary] [repeat tac_suffix]
+end define
+
+define cast_type
+    [primitive_type] [repeat dimension]
+    | [id] [repeat dot_id] [repeat dimension]
+end define
+
+define tac_unary
+      [unary_op] [tac_primary] [repeat tac_suffix]
+    | [tac_primary] [repeat tac_suffix]
+end define
+
+define unary_op
+    '- | '! | '~
+end define
+
+define tac_primary
+      [literal]
+    | 'new [primitive_type] [repeat new_array_dim]
+    | 'new [id] [repeat dot_id] [repeat new_array_dim]
+    | 'concat '( [list tac_expr] ')
+    | '( [tac_expr] ')
+    | [id]
+end define
+
+define new_array_dim
+    '[ [opt tac_expr] ']
+end define
+
+define tac_suffix
+      '. '< 'init '>  '( [list tac_expr] ')
+    | '. '< 'clinit '> '( [list tac_expr] ')
+    | '. [id] '( [list tac_expr] ')
+    | '. [id]
+    | '[ [tac_expr] ']
+    | '[ ']
+end define
+
+define literal
+    [number] | [stringlit] | [charlit] | 'null | 'true | 'false
+end define
\ No newline at end of file

+package io.github.lukawnb
+package steps
+
+import java.nio.file.Paths
+import java.util.concurrent.{ConcurrentHashMap, ConcurrentLinkedQueue, Executors}
+import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
+import scala.collection.mutable
+import scala.concurrent.{Await, ExecutionContext, Future}
+import scala.concurrent.duration.Duration
+import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*
+import scala.util.Using
+
+import core.*
+import core.Constants.*
+import core.utils.IrMethodParser
+import org.opalj.br.{ClassFile, IntValue, StringValue}
+import org.opalj.br.analyses.Project
+
+/** Collects per-method metadata from compiled class files and IR outputs:
+  *   1. For each compilation target, loads one OPAL Project per funcId directory to extract method
+  *      signatures and BCB source coordinates from @BCBIdentifierOriginalSourceCode annotations.
+  *   2. Concurrently scans all six IR variant directories (four JNorm, two ONorm) to collect
+  *      per-method line ranges.
+  *   3. Merges all results in a single pass, sorts entries by key for reproducibility, and
+  *      serializes to work/metadata/metadata.json.zst.
+  */
+class CollectMetadataStep extends Step:
+
+  override val name = "Collect Metadata (OPAL + IR Lines)"
+
+  private type ScanResult = (
+      positions: ConcurrentHashMap[(String, String), (Int, Int)],
+      enriched: Int,
+      keyMisses: Int,
+      examples: List[String]
+  )
+
+  private type IrVariant = (
+      dir: os.Path,
+      ext: String,
+      parse: os.Path => Map[String, (start: Int, end: Int)],
+      update: (MethodMetadata, Int, Int) => MethodMetadata
+  )
+
+  override def process(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val outFile = config.metadataDir / METADATA_FILE
+
+    if os.exists(outFile) then
+      Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Cache] Metadata already exists, skipping.")
+      return
+
+    val masterMap = mutable.Map[String, Map[String, MethodMetadata]]()
+
+    for t <- ALL_TARGETS do
+      val targetDir = config.compileDir / t
+      if os.exists(targetDir) then
+        val targetMap = new ConcurrentHashMap[String, MethodMetadata]()
+        val funcIdDirs = targetDir.funcIdSubDirs
+
+        runParallel(s"Metadata $t", funcIdDirs): funcIdDir =>
+          val project = Project(funcIdDir.toIO)
+          project.projectClassFilesWithSources.foreach: (classFile, url) =>
+            val srcPath = os.Path(Paths.get(url.toURI))
+            val relPath = s"$t/${srcPath.relativeTo(targetDir) / os.up}"
+            extractMetadata(classFile, t, relPath, targetMap)
+
+        val countMsg = s"  Target $t: ${targetMap.size()} methods found"
+        Log.pipeline.info(countMsg)
+        Log.metrics.info(countMsg)
+        masterMap(t) = targetMap.asScala.toMap
+
+    var metadata = masterMap.toMap
+
+    val allVariants = irVariants
+
+    val scanResults: List[Option[ScanResult]] =
+      Using.resource(Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()): outerExec =>
+        given ExecutionContext = ExecutionContext.fromExecutor(outerExec)
+        val futures = allVariants.map: v =>
+          Future:
+            if os.exists(v.dir) then Some(scanIrLines(metadata, v.dir, v.ext, v.parse))
+            else
+              Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Collect] ${v.dir.last} not found, skipping IR line enrichment")
+              None
+        Await.result(Future.sequence(futures), Duration.Inf)
+
+    val totalMetaCount = metadata.values.map(_.size).sum
+    allVariants.zip(scanResults).foreach: (v, resultOpt) =>
+      resultOpt.foreach: r =>
+        val collectMsg = s"  [Collect] ${r.enriched} entries enriched with ${v.ext} line positions"
+        Log.pipeline.info(collectMsg)
+        Log.metrics.info(collectMsg)
+        val diagMsg =
+          s"  [Diag]    Unenriched (abstract methods): ${totalMetaCount - r.enriched} | IR key mismatches: ${r.keyMisses}"
+        Log.pipeline.info(diagMsg)
+        Log.metrics.info(diagMsg)
+        if r.keyMisses > 0 then
+          val keyMissesMsg = s"  [Diag]    Mismatch examples (first 3):"
+          Log.pipeline.info(keyMissesMsg)
+          Log.metrics.info(keyMissesMsg)
+          r.examples.foreach: e =>
+            Log.pipeline.info(s"      $e")
+            Log.metrics.info(s"      $e")
+
+    val variantScans = allVariants.zip(scanResults)
+    metadata = metadata.map: (target, entries) =>
+      target -> entries.map: (k, m0) =>
+        k -> variantScans.foldLeft(m0):
+          case (m, (v, Some(r))) =>
+            Option(r.positions.get((target, k))) match
+              case Some((s, e)) => v.update(m, s, e)
+              case None         => m
+          case (m, _)            => m
+
+    val sorted = metadata.map((t, m) => t -> m.toSeq.sortBy(_._1).toMap)
+    os.makeDir.all(outFile / os.up)
+    outFile.writeZstd: out =>
+      val writer = new java.io.OutputStreamWriter(out, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)

+package io.github.lukawnb
+package steps
+
+import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue
+import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*
+
+import core.*
+import core.Constants.*
+import core.utils.{LargeMethod, ScanLargeMethods}
+import core.utils.CrossVersionMapper.buildCrossTarget
+import core.utils.RelPathCalculator.calculateRelPath
+
+/** Compiles stub Java sources and assembles the cross-version dataset:
+  *   1. Compile for Java 8, 11, 17 with version-specific javac.
+  *   2. Prune from target8 any fragment absent from target11 or target17 due to compilation
+  *      failure.
+  *   3. Scan class files for methods >= 5000 instructions (SootUp limit) and detect known SootUp
+  *      NullPointerException fragments.
+  *   4. Prune all detected exclusions from all three compilation targets.
+  *   5. Assemble targetCross via round-robin version assignment over an alphabetically sorted,
+  *      seed-42-shuffled fragment list, using target8 as the fragment directory reference.
+  */
+class CompileStep extends Step:
+
+  override val name = "Compile (Target 8, 11, 17 + Cross)"
+
+  private case class CompileFailure(relPath: String, version: Int, error: String)
+  private case class FragmentExclusion(funcId: Int, category: String, fragment: String)
+
+  private val javaHomeEnvs = Map(
+    8  -> JAVA_8_HOME_ENV,
+    11 -> JAVA_11_HOME_ENV,
+    17 -> JAVA_17_HOME_ENV
+  )
+
+  override def process(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val versions = List(8, 11, 17)
+    os.makeDir.all(config.failureDir)
+
+    val incomplete = versions.exists(v =>
+      config.funcIds.exists(id => !os.exists(config.compileDir / s"target$v" / id.toString))
+    )
+
+    val (largeMethodExclusions, nullPointerExclusions) =
+      if incomplete then runCompile(versions)
+      else
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Cache] Bytecode targets exist, skipping compilation.")
+        (
+          largeMethodExclusions = readLargeMethodsCSV(),
+          nullPointerExclusions = readNullPointerJSON()
+        )
+
+    val exclusions = (largeMethodExclusions ++ nullPointerExclusions)
+      .distinctBy(e => (e.funcId, e.category, e.fragment))
+    if exclusions.nonEmpty then pruneExclusions(exclusions)
+
+    if config.funcIds.exists(id => !os.exists(config.compileDir / TARGET_CROSS / id.toString)) then
+      buildCrossTarget(config.compileDir, CLASS_EXT)
+    else
+      Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Cache] Cross-version dataset exists, skipping cross-copy.")
+
+  // --- Compile ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def runCompile(versions: List[Int])(using config: RunConfig) =
+    val compilingJavaMsg =
+      s"  [Compile] Compiling Java ${versions.mkString(", ")} for funcIds ${config.funcIds.toSeq.sorted.mkString(",")}"
+    Log.pipeline.info(compilingJavaMsg)
+    Log.metrics.info(compilingJavaMsg)
+    versions.foreach(v => os.remove.all(config.compileDir / s"target$v"))
+
+    val jars =
+      for
+        funcIdDir   <- config.stubFilesDir.funcIdSubDirs
+        categoryDir <- funcIdDir.categorySubDirs
+        file        <- os.list(categoryDir) if file.ext == "jar"
+      yield file
+
+    val queue = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue[CompileFailure]()
+    for v <- versions do
+      val targetDir = config.compileDir / s"target$v"
+      os.makeDir.all(targetDir)
+      runParallel(s"Compile Java $v", jars): jar =>
+        val relPath = calculateRelPath(jar)
+        compileSingleFile(jar, v, targetDir, relPath).foreach(err =>
+          queue.add(CompileFailure(relPath.toString, v, err))
+        )
+
+    val failures = queue.asScala.toList
+    writeCompileFailures(failures)
+    if failures.nonEmpty then pruneTarget8(failures)
+
+    Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Compile] Scanning class files for large methods...")
+    val scanned = ScanLargeMethods.scan(config.compileDir)
+    writeLargeMethodsCSV(scanned)
+
+    val nullPointers = detectNullPointerCases
+    writeNullPointerJSON(nullPointers)
+
+    (
+      largeMethodExclusions = scanned.map(m => FragmentExclusion(m.funcId, m.category, m.fragment)),
+      nullPointerExclusions = nullPointers
+    )
+
+  // --- Prune helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def pruneTarget8(failures: List[CompileFailure])(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val removed = failures.map(_.relPath).toSet.count: relPath =>
+      val p = os.RelPath(relPath)
+      val folder = config.compileDir / TARGET_8 / p / os.up / s"_${p.last.stripSuffix(".jar")}"
+      if os.exists(folder) then
+        os.remove.all(folder)
+        true
+      else false
+    val pruneMsg =
+      s"  [Compile] Pruned $removed target8 fragment dir(s) not compilable for Java 11/17."
+    Log.pipeline.info(pruneMsg)
+    Log.metrics.info(pruneMsg)
+
+  private def pruneExclusions(exclusions: List[FragmentExclusion])(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val toRemove =
+      for
+        FragmentExclusion(funcId, category, fragment) <- exclusions
+        target                                        <- COMPILE_TARGETS
+        dir = config.compileDir / target / funcId.toString / category / fragment
+        if os.exists(dir)
+      yield dir
+    toRemove.foreach(os.remove.all)
+    val exclusionMsg =
+      s"  [Compile] Pruned ${toRemove.size} fragment dir(s) (SootUp exclusions) from target8/11/17."
+    Log.pipeline.info(exclusionMsg)
+    Log.metrics.info(exclusionMsg)
+
+  private def detectNullPointerCases(using config: RunConfig): List[FragmentExclusion] =
+    (for
+      target  <- COMPILE_TARGETS
+      targetDir = config.compileDir / target
+      if os.exists(targetDir)
+      funcDir <- targetDir.funcIdSubDirs
+      catDir  <- funcDir.categorySubDirs
+      instDir <- os.list(catDir) if SOOTUP_NULLPOINTER_IDS.contains(instDir.last)
+    yield FragmentExclusion(funcDir.last.toInt, catDir.last, instDir.last)).toList.distinct
+
+  // --- File I/O ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def writeCompileFailures(failures: List[CompileFailure])(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val sorted = failures.sortBy(f => (f.relPath, f.version))
+    val json = ujson.Arr(sorted.map(f =>
+      ujson.Obj("relPath" -> f.relPath, "version" -> f.version, "error" -> f.error.trim)
+    )*)
+    os.write.over(config.failureDir / COMPILE_FAILURES_FILE, ujson.write(json, indent = 2))
+    val failMsg =
+      s"  [Compile] ${sorted.size} compilation failure(s) -> $COMPILE_FAILURE_DIR/$COMPILE_FAILURES_FILE"
+    Log.pipeline.info(failMsg)
+    Log.metrics.info(failMsg)
+
+  private def writeLargeMethodsCSV(rows: List[LargeMethod])(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val header = "\"FuncId\",\"Category\",\"Fragment\",\"Class\",\"KB\",\"MaxInstr\""
+    val lines = rows.map(m =>
+      s""""${m.funcId}","${m.category}","${m.fragment}","${m.className}","${m.kb}","${m.maxInstr}""""
+    )
+    os.write.over(
+      config.failureDir / SOOTUP_LARGE_METHODS_FILE,
+      (header +: lines).mkString("\n") + "\n"
+    )
+    val largeMsg =
+      s"  [Compile] ${rows.size} large method class file(s) -> $COMPILE_FAILURE_DIR/$SOOTUP_LARGE_METHODS_FILE"
+    Log.pipeline.info(largeMsg)
+    Log.metrics.info(largeMsg)
+
+  private def readLargeMethodsCSV()(using config: RunConfig): List[FragmentExclusion] =
+    val f = config.failureDir / SOOTUP_LARGE_METHODS_FILE
+    Option.when(os.exists(f)):
+      os.read.lines(f).drop(1).filter(_.trim.nonEmpty).map: line =>
+        val p = line.split(",").map(_.trim.stripPrefix("\"").stripSuffix("\""))
+        FragmentExclusion(p(0).toInt, p(1), p(2))
+      .toList
+    .getOrElse(Nil)
+
+  private def writeNullPointerJSON(exclusions: List[FragmentExclusion])(using
+      config: RunConfig
+  ): Unit =
+    val json = ujson.Arr(exclusions.map(e =>
+      ujson.Obj(
+        "funcId"   -> e.funcId,
+        "category" -> e.category,
+        "fragment" -> e.fragment,
+        "reason"   -> "SootUp NullPointerException"
+      )
+    )*)
+    os.write.over(config.failureDir / SOOTUP_NULLPOINTER_FILE, ujson.write(json, indent = 2))
+    val npMsg =
+      s"  [Compile] ${exclusions.size} SootUp NullPointer fragment(s) -> $COMPILE_FAILURE_DIR/$SOOTUP_NULLPOINTER_FILE"
+    Log.pipeline.info(npMsg)
+    Log.metrics.info(npMsg)
+
+  private def readNullPointerJSON()(using config: RunConfig): List[FragmentExclusion] =
+    val f = config.failureDir / SOOTUP_NULLPOINTER_FILE
+    Option.when(os.exists(f)):
+      ujson.read(os.read(f)).arr.toList.map: o =>
+        FragmentExclusion(o("funcId").num.toInt, o("category").str, o("fragment").str)
+    .getOrElse(Nil)
+
+  // --- javac invocation -------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def compileSingleFile(
+      jar: os.Path,
+      version: Int,
+      targetDir: os.Path,
+      relPath: os.RelPath
+  ): Option[String] =
+    val javaFile = (jar / os.up) / s"${jar.baseName}.java"
+    val compileDest = (targetDir / relPath) / os.up
+    os.makeDir.all(compileDest)
+    val versionFlags: Seq[String] =
+      if version == 8 then Seq("-source", "1.8", "-target", "1.8")
+      else Seq("--release", version.toString)
+    val result = os.proc(
+      javacPath(version),
+      versionFlags,
+      "-encoding",
+      "UTF-8",
+      "-cp",
+      s"$jar${java.io.File.pathSeparator}.",
+      "-sourcepath",
+      "",
+      "-d",
+      compileDest,
+      javaFile
+    ).call(check = false, stdout = os.Pipe, stderr = os.Pipe)
+    Option.when(result.exitCode != 0)(result.err.text())
+
+  private def javacPath(version: Int): String =
+    javaHomeEnvs.get(version).flatMap(sys.env.get).map(h => s"$h/bin/javac").getOrElse("javac")

+      else
+        ujson.read(os.read(f)).arr
+          .map(o => (o("category").str, o("fragment").str.stripPrefix("_") + ".java"))
+          .toSet
+
+    def removeFailures(label: String, failures: Set[(String, String)]): Unit =
+      if failures.isEmpty then
+        val msg = s"  [Eval] $label: no failures recorded -- nothing removed from BCB."
+        Log.pipeline.info(msg)
+        Log.metrics.info(msg)
+        return
+      var rClones = 0
+      var rFp = 0
+      var rFuncs = 0
+      val st = conn.createStatement()
+      for (fType, fName) <- failures do
+        val sub = s"SELECT id FROM functions WHERE name='$fName' AND type='$fType'"
+        rClones += st.executeUpdate(
+          s"DELETE FROM clones WHERE function_id_one IN ($sub) OR function_id_two IN ($sub)"
+        )
+        rFp += st.executeUpdate(
+          s"DELETE FROM false_positives WHERE function_id_one IN ($sub) OR function_id_two IN ($sub)"
+        )
+        rFuncs += st.executeUpdate(s"DELETE FROM functions WHERE name='$fName' AND type='$fType'")
+      st.close()
+      val msg =
+        s"  [Eval] $label: ${failures.size} file(s) -> removed $rFuncs function(s), $rClones clone pair(s), $rFp false positive(s) from BCB."
+      Log.pipeline.info(msg)
+      Log.metrics.info(msg)
+
+    removeFailures("Compile failures", compileFails)
+    removeFailures("SootUp large methods", largeMethodFails)
+    removeFailures("SootUp nullPointer", nullPointerFails)
+
+    val totalFiles = (compileFails | largeMethodFails | nullPointerFails).size
+    if totalFiles > 0 then
+      val msg = s"  [Eval] Failure cleanup total: $totalFiles distinct file(s) removed from BCB."
+      Log.pipeline.info(msg)
+      Log.metrics.info(msg)
+
+  // --- Tool registration ------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def registerTools(bceEnv: os.Path, renaming: String)(using
+      config: RunConfig
+  ) =
+    Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Eval] [$renaming] Registering tools in BCE...")
+    val pairs =
+      for
+        mode   <- IrMode.values.toList
+        target <- mode.targets
+        csv = config.mappingDir / mode.workDir / renaming / target / MAPPING_CLONES_FILE
+        if os.exists(csv)
+      yield
+        val toolName = mode.toolName(renaming, target)
+        val id = ToolId:
+          bce(
+            bceEnv,
+            "tasks.RegisterTool",
+            "-n",
+            toolName,
+            "-d",
+            s"${mode.label} IR, rename=$renaming, $target"
+          )()
+            .out.text().trim.toLong
+        val msg = s"  [Eval] [$renaming] Registered '$toolName' -> ID ${id.show}"
+        Log.pipeline.info(msg)
+        Log.metrics.info(msg)
+        toolName -> id
+    val json = ujson.Obj.from(pairs.map((k, id) => k -> ujson.Num(id.value.toDouble)))
+    os.write.over(
+      config.evalWorkDir / renaming / "tool-ids.json",
+      ujson.write(json, indent = 2),
+      createFolders = true
+    )
+    pairs.toMap
+
+  // --- Clone import -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def importClones(bceEnv: os.Path, toolIds: Map[String, ToolId], renaming: String)(using
+      config: RunConfig
+  ): Unit =
+    Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Eval] [$renaming] Importing clones into BCE...")
+    for
+      mode   <- IrMode.values.toList
+      target <- mode.targets
+      toolName = s"${mode.label}-${renaming.capitalize}_$target"
+      id     <- toolIds.get(toolName)
+      csv = config.mappingDir / mode.workDir / renaming / target / MAPPING_CLONES_FILE
+      if os.exists(csv)
+    do
+      val n = bce(bceEnv, "tasks.ImportClones", "-t", id.show, "-c", csv.toString)().out.text().trim
+      val msg = s"  [Eval] [$renaming] Imported $n clone pairs for '$toolName'"
+      Log.pipeline.info(msg)
+      Log.metrics.info(msg)
+
+  // --- Recall evaluation ------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def evaluate(bceEnv: os.Path, toolIds: Map[String, ToolId], renaming: String)(using
+      config: RunConfig
+  ): Unit =
+    Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Eval] [$renaming] Running BCE recall evaluation...")
+    for
+      mode   <- IrMode.values.toList
+      target <- mode.targets
+      toolName = s"${mode.label}-${renaming.capitalize}_$target"
+      id     <- toolIds.get(toolName)
+    do
+      val outDir = config.evalResultsDir / renaming
+      os.makeDir.all(outDir)
+      val report = outDir / s"$toolName.txt"
+      if os.exists(report) then
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Cache] [$renaming] $toolName -- skipping")
+      else
+        val tmpReport = bceEnv / s"$toolName.txt.tmp"
+        val reportStart = System.currentTimeMillis()
+        bce(
+          bceEnv,
+          "tasks.EvaluateTool",
+          "-t",
+          id.show,
+          "-o",
+          tmpReport.toString,
+          "--st",
+          "BOTH",
+          "--mil",
+          MinLines.toString,
+          "--mip",
+          MinPretty.toString,
+          "--mit",
+          MinTokens.toString,
+          "-m",
+          "CoverageMatcher 0.7",
+          "-s",
+          "0"
+        )(bceHeapMb)
+        os.move(tmpReport, report, replaceExisting = true)
+        val elapsed = formatDuration(System.currentTimeMillis() - reportStart)
+        val msg = s"  [Eval] [$renaming] Recall report -> $report  ($elapsed)"
+        Log.pipeline.info(msg)
+        Log.metrics.info(msg)
+
+  // --- Summary table ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private case class SummaryRow(
+      name: String,
+      pairs: Long,
+      t1: Double,
+      t2: Double,
+      t2blind: Double,
+      t2consistent: Double,
+      vst3: Double,
+      st3: Double,
+      mt3: Double,
+      wt3: Double,
+      interT1: Double,
+      intraT1: Double,
+      interT2: Double,
+      intraT2: Double,
+      interT2blind: Double,
+      intraT2blind: Double,
+      interT2consistent: Double,
+      intraT2consistent: Double,
+      interVst3: Double,
+      intraVst3: Double,
+      interSt3: Double,
+      intraSt3: Double,
+      interMt3: Double,
+      intraMt3: Double,
+      interWt3: Double,
+      intraWt3: Double
+  )

+  private def writeSummary(toolIds: Map[String, ToolId], renaming: String)(using
+      config: RunConfig
+  ): Unit =
+    val renamingDir = config.evalResultsDir / renaming
+    val rows =
+      for
+        mode   <- IrMode.values.toList
+        target <- mode.targets
+        toolName = mode.toolName(renaming, target)
+        if toolIds.contains(toolName)
+        txt = renamingDir / s"$toolName.txt"
+        if os.exists(txt)
+      yield parseRow(toolName, txt)
+
+    if rows.nonEmpty then
+      val cfgPath = NICAD_CFG_DIR / s"$NICAD_CFG_STEM-$renaming.cfg"
+      val nicadParams = Option.when(os.exists(cfgPath)):
+        val keys = Set("threshold", "minsize", "rename")
+        os.read.lines(cfgPath)
+          .filter(l => l.trim.nonEmpty && !l.trim.startsWith("#"))
+          .map(_.trim)
+          .filter(l => keys.exists(l.startsWith))
+          .mkString(", ")
+      .getOrElse("(config not found)")
+      val configBlock =
+        s"NiCad: granularity=functions, $nicadParams\n" +
+          s"BCE:   CoverageMatcher(coverage=0.7), minLines=$MinLines, minPrettyLines=$MinPretty, minTokens=$MinTokens"
+      val outFile = renamingDir / "summary.txt"
+      os.write.over(outFile, formatSummary(rows, configBlock))
+      Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Eval] Summary ($renaming) -> $outFile")
+
+  private def parseRow(name: String, txtFile: os.Path) =
+    val tl = os.read.lines(txtFile).toVector
+
+    def sectionValue(sectionHdr: String, typePrefix: String): Double =
+      boundary:
+        val si = tl.indexWhere(_.contains(sectionHdr))
+        if si < 0 then break(0.0)
+        tl.drop(si + 1)
+          .dropWhile(l => l.trim.startsWith("--") || l.trim.isEmpty)
+          .takeWhile(l => l.trim.nonEmpty && !l.trim.startsWith("--"))
+          .find(_.trim.startsWith(typePrefix))
+          .flatMap: l =>
+            val v = l.substring(l.lastIndexOf('=') + 1).trim
+            Option.unless(v == "NaN")(v).flatMap(_.toDoubleOption)
+          .getOrElse(0.0)
+
+    def all(t: String) = sectionValue("Recall Per Clone Type (type:", t)
+    def inter(t: String) = sectionValue("Inter-Project Recall Per Clone Type", t)
+    def intra(t: String) = sectionValue("Intra-Project Recall Per Clone Type", t)
+
+    val pairs = tl.find(_.trim.startsWith("#Clones:"))
+      .flatMap(_.split(':').lastOption).flatMap(_.trim.toLongOption).getOrElse(0L)
+
+    SummaryRow(
+      name,
+      pairs,
+      t1                = all("Type-1:"),
+      t2                = all("Type-2:"),
+      t2blind           = all("Type-2 (blind):"),
+      t2consistent      = all("Type-2 (consistent):"),
+      vst3              = all("Very-Strongly Type-3:"),
+      st3               = all("Strongly Type-3:"),
+      mt3               = all("Moderatly Type-3:"),
+      wt3               = all("Weakly Type-3/Type-4:"),
+      interT1           = inter("Type-1:"),
+      intraT1           = intra("Type-1:"),
+      interT2           = inter("Type-2:"),
+      intraT2           = intra("Type-2:"),
+      interT2blind      = inter("Type-2 (blind):"),
+      intraT2blind      = intra("Type-2 (blind):"),
+      interT2consistent = inter("Type-2 (consistent):"),
+      intraT2consistent = intra("Type-2 (consistent):"),
+      interVst3         = inter("Very-Strongly Type-3:"),
+      intraVst3         = intra("Very-Strongly Type-3:"),
+      interSt3          = inter("Strongly Type-3:"),
+      intraSt3          = intra("Strongly Type-3:"),
+      interMt3          = inter("Moderatly Type-3:"),
+      intraMt3          = intra("Moderatly Type-3:"),
+      interWt3          = inter("Weakly Type-3/Type-4:"),
+      intraWt3          = intra("Weakly Type-3/Type-4:")
+    )
+
+  private def formatSummary(rows: Seq[SummaryRow], configBlock: String) =
+    val nw = rows.map(_.name.length).max
+
+    extension (d: Double) private def pct = f"${d * 100}%5.1f"
+
+    case class Col(hdr: String, w: Int, right: Boolean = true)
+
+    def pad(v: String, c: Col): String =
+      if c.right then " " * (c.w - v.length).max(0) + v
+      else v.padTo(c.w, ' ')
+
+    def mkRow(cols: Seq[Col])(vals: Seq[String]): String =
+      cols.zip(vals).map((c, v) => pad(v, c)).mkString(" | ")
+
+    def mkTable(cols: Seq[Col], data: Seq[Seq[String]]): String =
+      val hdr = mkRow(cols)(cols.map(_.hdr))
+      val sep = cols.map(c => "-" * c.w).mkString("-+-")
+      val body = data.map(mkRow(cols)).mkString("\n")
+      s"$hdr\n$sep\n$body"
+
+    val cols1 = Seq(
+      Col("Tool", nw, right = false),
+      Col("Pairs", 7),
+      Col("T1%", 5),
+      Col("T2%", 5),
+      Col("T2b%", 5),
+      Col("T2c%", 5),
+      Col("VST3%", 5),
+      Col("ST3%", 5),
+      Col("MT3%", 5),
+      Col("WT3%", 5)
+    )
+
+    val data1 = rows.map: r =>
+      Seq(
+        r.name,
+        f"${r.pairs}%7d",
+        r.t1.pct,
+        r.t2.pct,
+        r.t2blind.pct,
+        r.t2consistent.pct,
+        r.vst3.pct,
+        r.st3.pct,
+        r.mt3.pct,
+        r.wt3.pct
+      )
+
+    val cols2 = Seq(
+      Col("Tool", nw, right = false),
+      Col("T1%", 5),
+      Col("T1-Inter%", 9),
+      Col("T1-Intra%", 9),
+      Col("T2%", 5),
+      Col("T2-Inter%", 9),
+      Col("T2-Intra%", 9),
+      Col("T2b%", 5),
+      Col("T2b-Inter%", 10),
+      Col("T2b-Intra%", 10),
+      Col("T2c%", 5),
+      Col("T2c-Inter%", 10),
+      Col("T2c-Intra%", 10),
+      Col("VST3%", 5),
+      Col("VST3-Inter%", 11),
+      Col("VST3-Intra%", 11),
+      Col("ST3%", 5),
+      Col("ST3-Inter%", 10),
+      Col("ST3-Intra%", 10),
+      Col("MT3%", 5),
+      Col("MT3-Inter%", 10),
+      Col("MT3-Intra%", 10),
+      Col("WT3%", 5),
+      Col("WT3-Inter%", 10),
+      Col("WT3-Intra%", 10)
+    )
+
+    val data2 = rows.map: r =>
+      Seq(
+        r.name,
+        r.t1.pct,
+        r.interT1.pct,
+        r.intraT1.pct,
+        r.t2.pct,
+        r.interT2.pct,
+        r.intraT2.pct,
+        r.t2blind.pct,
+        r.interT2blind.pct,
+        r.intraT2blind.pct,
+        r.t2consistent.pct,
+        r.interT2consistent.pct,
+        r.intraT2consistent.pct,
+        r.vst3.pct,
+        r.interVst3.pct,
+        r.intraVst3.pct,
+        r.st3.pct,
+        r.interSt3.pct,
+        r.intraSt3.pct,
+        r.mt3.pct,
+        r.interMt3.pct,
+        r.intraMt3.pct,
+        r.wt3.pct,
+        r.interWt3.pct,
+        r.intraWt3.pct
+      )
+
+    s"""$configBlock
+       |
+       |== BCE Recall per Clone Type (CoverageMatcher 0.7, all functionalities, %) ==
+       |   T2b = Type-2 (blind), T2c = Type-2 (consistent), WT3 = Weakly Type-3/Type-4
+       |
+       |${mkTable(cols1, data1)}
+       |
+       |== Recall Breakdown: Inter-Project vs Intra-Project (CoverageMatcher 0.7, %) ==
+       |
+       |${mkTable(cols2, data2)}
+       |""".stripMargin
+
+  // --- BCE subprocess helper --------------------------------------------------
+
+  private def bce(cwd: os.Path, mainClass: String, args: String*)(heapMb: Int = 0) =
+    val cp = s"${BCE_DIR / "bin"}/:${BCE_DIR / "libs"}/*"
+    val jvmArgs = if heapMb > 0 then Seq(s"-Xmx${heapMb}m", "-XX:+UseParallelGC") else Nil
+    val mdcSnapshot = Option(MDC.getCopyOfContextMap)
+    os.proc("java", jvmArgs, "-cp", cp, mainClass, args)
+      .call(
+        cwd    = cwd,
+        stdout = os.Pipe,
+        stderr = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line =>
+          mdcSnapshot.foreach(MDC.setContextMap)
+          Log.bce.info(line)
+        )
+      )

+package io.github.lukawnb
+package steps
+
+import core.*
+import core.Constants.*
+
+/** Extracts Java source files from the IJaDataset2.0 archive into work/source/targetSource/:
+  *   1. Build a file list using compiled target8 as reference for present fragments.
+  *   2. Extract the matching Java source files from the archive.
+  *   3. Strip UTF-8 BOMs from all extracted files to ensure TXL parseability.
+  */
+class ExtractSourceStep extends Step:
+
+  override val name = "Extract Source (IJaDataset2.0)"
+
+  override def process(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val tgz = os.list(config.dataDir)
+      .find(p => p.last.endsWith(".tar.gz"))
+      .getOrElse(throw RuntimeException("No .tar.gz source dataset found in data/"))
+
+    val compileTarget8 = config.compileDir / TARGET_8
+    if !os.exists(compileTarget8) then
+      throw RuntimeException(s"CompileStep must run first -- $compileTarget8 not found")
+
+    if os.exists(config.sourceDir) then
+      Log.pipeline.info("  [Cache] Source already extracted -- skipping")
+    else
+      val tgzRoot = os.proc("tar", "-tzf", tgz)
+        .call().out.lines().headOption
+        .map(_.split('/').head)
+        .getOrElse(throw RuntimeException(s"Cannot determine root dir in ${tgz.last}"))
+
+      val fileList =
+        for
+          funcIdDir <- compileTarget8.funcIdSubDirs.sortBy(_.last.toInt)
+          catDir    <- funcIdDir.categorySubDirs
+          p         <- os.list(catDir).filter(os.isDir)
+        yield s"$tgzRoot/${funcIdDir.last}/${catDir.last}/${p.last.stripPrefix("_")}.java"
+
+      if fileList.nonEmpty then
+        val listFile = os.temp(contents = fileList.mkString("\n"), suffix = ".txt")
+        try
+          os.makeDir.all(config.sourceDir)
+          os.proc(
+            "tar",
+            "-xzf",
+            tgz,
+            "--strip-components=1",
+            "-C",
+            config.sourceDir,
+            "--files-from",
+            listFile,
+            "--ignore-failed-read"
+          ).call(
+            stdout = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line => Log.pipeline.info(line)),
+            stderr = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line => Log.pipeline.warn(line)),
+            check  = false
+          )
+        finally
+          os.remove(listFile): Unit
+
+        val extracted = fileList.count: entry =>
+          val parts = entry.split('/')
+          os.exists(config.sourceDir / parts(1) / parts(2) / parts(3))
+        val misses = fileList.size - extracted
+        if misses > 0 then
+          val missMsg =
+            s"  [ExtractSource] $misses source file(s) not found in archive"
+          Log.pipeline.warn(missMsg)
+          Log.metrics.warn(missMsg)
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [ExtractSource] $extracted source files -> ${config.sourceDir}")
+      else
+        Log.pipeline.info("  [ExtractSource] No files to extract -- skipping")
+
+    if os.exists(config.sourceDir) then stripUtf8Boms(config.sourceDir)
+
+  // Some BCB source files carry a UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) which TXL attaches to the first keyword,
+  // breaking tokenization. Strip it once after extraction; subsequent runs are no-ops.
+  private def stripUtf8Boms(sourceDir: os.Path): Unit =
+    var stripped = 0
+    for
+      funcIdDir <- os.list(sourceDir)
+      catDir    <- os.list(funcIdDir)
+      path      <- os.list(catDir).filter(_.ext == "java")
+    do
+      val bytes = os.read.bytes(path)
+      if bytes.length >= 3 && bytes(0) == 0xef.toByte && bytes(1) == 0xbb.toByte &&
+        bytes(2) == 0xbf.toByte
+      then
+        os.write.over(path, bytes.drop(3))
+        stripped += 1
+    Log.pipeline.info(s"  [ExtractSource] BOM strip: $stripped files updated.")

+package io.github.lukawnb
+package steps
+
+import core.{Log, RunConfig, Step}
+import core.Constants.*
+
+extension (p: os.Path)
+  private def isDbZip: Boolean = p.baseName == BCB_DB_NAME
+
+/** Extracts prepared Stubber tool artifacts from their ZIP packages into work/extract/:
+  *   1. Extract the BCB H2 clone database (non-compilable entries removed).
+  *   2. Extract stub Java sources scoped to active funcIds.
+  */
+class ExtractStep extends Step:
+  override val name = "Extract (BCB Database + Stubs)"
+
+  override def process(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val zipFiles = os.list(config.dataDir).filter(_.ext == "zip")
+    extractDb(zipFiles)
+    extractStubs(zipFiles)
+
+  private def extractDb(zipFiles: Seq[os.Path])(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    zipFiles.find(_.isDbZip).foreach: zip =>
+      orCached(config.bcbExtractDir):
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Extract] ${zip.last}...")
+        os.makeDir.all(config.bcbExtractDir)
+        os.proc("unzip", "-n", "-q", zip, "-d", config.bcbExtractDir)
+          .call(
+            stdout = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line => Log.pipeline.info(line)),
+            stderr = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line => Log.pipeline.warn(line))
+          )
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Done] ${zip.last} -> ${config.bcbExtractDir}")
+
+  private def extractStubs(zipFiles: Seq[os.Path])(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    zipFiles.filterNot(_.isDbZip).headOption.foreach: zip =>
+      orCached(config.stubFilesDir):
+        val sortedFuncIds = config.funcIds.toSeq.sorted
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Extract] ${zip.last} (funcIds: ${sortedFuncIds.mkString(",")})...")
+        os.makeDir.all(config.extractDir)
+        os.proc(
+          "unzip",
+          "-n",
+          "-q",
+          zip,
+          sortedFuncIds.map(id => s"${zip.baseName}/$id/*"),
+          "-d",
+          config.extractDir
+        )
+          .call(
+            stdout = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line => Log.pipeline.info(line)),
+            stderr = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line => Log.pipeline.warn(line))
+          )
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Done] ${config.funcIds.size} funcId(s) -> ${config.stubFilesDir}")
+
+  private def orCached(dir: os.Path)(extract: => Unit): Unit =
+    if os.exists(dir) then Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Cache] ${dir.last} already extracted, skipping.")

+package io.github.lukawnb

+

+
+enum JNormVariant(
+    val workDir: String,
+    val jar: os.Path,
+    val javaHomeEnv: String,
+    val flags: Seq[String],
+    val useSymlinks: Boolean,
+    val escapeControlBytes: Boolean
+):
+  case SootStd   extends JNormVariant(
+        JNORM_SOOT_WORK_DIR,
+        JNORM_CLI,
+        JAVA_8_HOME_ENV,
+        Seq("-o", "-n", "-s", "-p"),
+        true,
+        false
+      )
+  case SootAgg   extends JNormVariant(
+        JNORM_SOOT_AGG_WORK_DIR,
+        JNORM_CLI,
+        JAVA_8_HOME_ENV,
+        Seq("-o", "-n", "-s", "-p", "-a"),
+        true,
+        false
+      )
+  case SootUpStd extends JNormVariant(
+        JNORM_SOOTUP_WORK_DIR,
+        JNORM_SOOTUP_CLI,
+        JAVA_17_HOME_ENV,
+        Seq("-o", "-n"),
+        false,
+        true
+      )
+  case SootUpAgg extends JNormVariant(
+        JNORM_SOOTUP_AGG_WORK_DIR,
+        JNORM_SOOTUP_CLI,
+        JAVA_17_HOME_ENV,
+        Seq("-o", "-n", "-a"),
+        false,
+        true
+      )
+
+/** Runs all four JNorm variants (Soot/SootUp x std/agg) over compiled class files:

+  *   2. Sequentially recover OOM/timeout-failed batches via binary search at 85% total RAM

+  *   3. Build targetCross; escape control bytes in Jimple string literals (SootUp variants only).

+  private def runVariant(variant: JNormVariant)(using config: RunConfig): Unit =

+    val jnormDir = config.workDir / variant.workDir

+        val inputDir = compileDir / t
+        if !os.exists(inputDir) then

+                      relPath  = categoryDir.relativeTo(inputDir),

+                      batchIdx = idx

+      val retried = AtomicInteger(0)
+      val skipped = AtomicInteger(0)

+        s"  [Done] ${variant.workDir}: ${succeeded.get()} OK, ${retried.get()} retried, ${skipped.get()} skipped -- $total total"

+  // flatDir and batchIn live in /tmp so all JNorm JVM writes stay off the host mount
+  // (avoids host-mount virtualization overhead on Windows/macOS Docker);
+  // only the final .jimple move to outCategory touches the mounted filesystem.
+  private def runBatch(
+      variant: JNormVariant,
+      fragments: IndexedSeq[os.Path],
+      suffix: String,
+      outCategory: os.Path,
+      heapMb: Int,
+      timeoutMs: Long
+  ): Boolean =
+    val tmpBase = os.temp.dir(prefix = "jnorm-batch-")
+    try
+      val flatDir = tmpBase / "flat"
+      val batchIn = tmpBase / "in"
+      os.makeDir.all(flatDir)
+      os.makeDir.all(batchIn)
+      if variant.useSymlinks then

+        fragments.foreach(d => os.copy(d, batchIn / d.last, createFolders = true))

+      val exitCode =
+        try
+          os.proc(
+            javaExe(variant),
+            s"-Xmx${heapMb}m",
+            "-XX:ParallelGCThreads=1",
+            "-jar",
+            variant.jar,
+            variant.flags,
+            "-i",
+            batchIn,
+            "-d",
+            flatDir
+          )
+            .call(
+              check   = false,
+              stdout  = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line =>
+                mdcSnapshot.foreach(MDC.setContextMap)
+                Log.jnorm.info(line)
+              ),
+              stderr  = os.ProcessOutput.Readlines(line =>
+                mdcSnapshot.foreach(MDC.setContextMap)
+                Log.jnorm.warn(line)
+              ),
+              timeout = timeoutMs
+            )
+            .exitCode
+        catch
+          case _: Exception =>
+            Log.pipeline.warn(
+              s"  [Timeout] ${variant.workDir} $suffix -- exceeded ${timeoutMs / 60000} min"
+            )

+        os.list(flatDir).filter(_.ext == "jimple").foreach: flatFile =>
+          JnormOutputMapper.reconstructPath(flatFile, outCategory) match
+            case Some(dest) =>
+              os.makeDir.all(dest / os.up)
+              os.move(flatFile, dest, replaceExisting = true)
+            case None       => ()

+      else
+        false
+    finally
+      os.remove.all(tmpBase)
+
+  // Timeout scales with sub-batch size -- pathological single fragments fail fast.
+  // At leaf (size == 1) the fragment is tried alone with full heap before being skipped.
+  private def retryBinarySearch(
+      variant: JNormVariant,
+      fragments: IndexedSeq[os.Path],
+      suffix: String,
+      outCategory: os.Path,
+      retried: AtomicInteger,
+      skipped: AtomicInteger,
+      depth: Int = 0
+  ): Unit =
+    if depth == 0 then
+      Log.pipeline.info(
+        s"  [BinarySearch] Isolating failure in ${outCategory.segments.toVector.takeRight(3).mkString("/")} (${fragments.size} fragments)..."
+      )
+    val timeoutMs = (fragments.size.toLong * 2000L).max(600_000L)
+    if fragments.size > 1 then
+      val mid = fragments.size / 2
+      if runBatch(variant, fragments.take(mid), s"${suffix}L", outCategory, retryHeapMb, timeoutMs)
+      then
+        retried.addAndGet(mid)
+      else
+        retryBinarySearch(
+          variant,
+          fragments.take(mid),
+          s"${suffix}L",
+          outCategory,
+          retried,
+          skipped,
+          depth + 1
+        )
+      if runBatch(variant, fragments.drop(mid), s"${suffix}R", outCategory, retryHeapMb, timeoutMs)
+      then
+        retried.addAndGet(fragments.size - mid): Unit
+      else
+        retryBinarySearch(
+          variant,
+          fragments.drop(mid),
+          s"${suffix}R",
+          outCategory,
+          retried,
+          skipped,
+          depth + 1
+        )
+    else
+      if runBatch(variant, fragments, s"${suffix}_s", outCategory, retryHeapMb, timeoutMs) then
+        retried.incrementAndGet(): Unit
+      else
+        skipped.incrementAndGet()
+        val skipMsg =
+          s"  [Skip] ${variant.workDir} -- cannot process at ${retryHeapMb}MB: ${fragments.head}"
+        Log.pipeline.error(skipMsg)
+        Log.metrics.error(skipMsg)
+
+  // Replaces raw control bytes in Jimple string literals with \uXXXX escapes so TXL's [stringlit] tokenizer can read the files.
+  private def applyControlByteEscaping(
+      variant: JNormVariant,
+      jnormDir: os.Path
+  )(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val funcIdDirs =
+      ALL_TARGETS.flatMap: t =>
+        val tDir = jnormDir / t
+        if os.exists(tDir) then tDir.funcIdSubDirs else Seq.empty
+    if funcIdDirs.isEmpty then return
+    Log.pipeline.info(
+      s"  [Fix] Escaping control bytes in string literals (${variant.workDir})..."
+    )
+    val fixedCount = AtomicInteger(0)
+    runParallel(s"ControlByteEscape ${variant.workDir}", funcIdDirs, CPU * 2): funcIdDir =>
+      (for
+        categoryDir <- funcIdDir.categorySubDirs
+        fragmentDir <- categoryDir.fragmentSubDirs
+        path        <- os.list(fragmentDir).filter(_.ext == "jimple")
+      yield path).foreach: path =>
+        escapeControlBytesInContent(os.read(path)).foreach: fixed =>
+          os.write.over(path, fixed)
+          fixedCount.incrementAndGet()
+    val fixedFilesMsg = s"  [Fix] ${fixedCount.get()} files updated."
+    Log.pipeline.info(fixedFilesMsg)
+    Log.metrics.info(fixedFilesMsg)
+
+  // Returns the corrected content when the file contained at least one raw control byte
+  // (0x00-0x1F except tab, or 0x7F DEL) inside a double-quoted string literal, otherwise returns None.
+  private def escapeControlBytesInContent(content: String): Option[String] =
+    val sb = new java.lang.StringBuilder(content.length)
+    var inString = false
+    var changed = false
+    var i = 0
+    while i < content.length do
+      val c = content.charAt(i)
+      if inString then
+        c match
+          case '\\'                                             =>
+            sb.append(c)
+            if i + 1 < content.length then
+              i += 1
+              sb.append(content.charAt(i)): Unit
+          case '"'                                              =>
+            inString = false
+            sb.append(c)
+          case '\n'                                             =>
+            sb.append("\\u000a")
+            changed = true
+          case '\r'                                             =>
+            // bare \r: escape; \r\n: skip \r, LF handled next iteration
+            if i + 1 >= content.length || content.charAt(i + 1) != '\n' then
+              sb.append("\\u000d")
+              changed = true
+          case c2 if (c2 < ' ' || c2 == '\u007f') && c2 != '\t' =>
+            sb.append("\\u%04x".format(c2.toInt))
+            changed = true
+          case _                                                =>
+            sb.append(c)
+      else
+        if c == '"' then inString = true
+        sb.append(c)
+      i += 1
+    Option.when(changed)(sb.toString)

+package io.github.lukawnb
+package steps
+
+import java.io.{BufferedWriter, FileWriter, InputStream, PrintWriter}
+
+import core.*
+import core.Constants.*
+import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory
+import org.xml.sax.Attributes
+import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
+
+/** Maps NiCad clone XML output to BigCloneEval import CSV (BCB coordinates per clone fragment)
+  * across 3 NiCad renamings x (6 IR variants x 4 targets + 1 source baseline):
+  *   1. Load metadata and build a lookup index from IR file position to BCB coordinates (IR modes
+  *      only).
+  *   2. For each combination in parallel, stream NiCad XML clone pairs via SAX and write a
+  *      deduplicated CSV:
+  *      - IR modes: resolve BCB coordinates via the metadata index; deduplicate with sort -u.
+  *      - Source mode: extract BCB coordinates directly from file paths; deduplicate with a
+  *        seen-set.
+  */
+class MapClonesStep extends Step:
+
+  override val name = "Map Clones to BCB CSV"
+
+  private val modeDefs =
+    IR_MODES.map((mode, lang) => (mode, lang, ALL_TARGETS)) :+
+      (SOURCE_WORK_DIR, SOURCE_LANG, List(SOURCE_TARGET))
+
+  private type Idx = Map[(String, String, String, Int, Int), MethodMetadata]
+
+  override def process(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val jobs =
+      for
+        (mode, ext, targets) <- modeDefs
+        renaming             <- NICAD_ALL_RENAMINGS
+        target               <- targets
+        xmlFile = config.nicadDir / mode / renaming / target / NICAD_CLONES_FILE
+        outFile = config.mappingDir / mode / renaming / target / MAPPING_CLONES_FILE
+        if os.exists(xmlFile)
+      yield (
+        mode     = mode,
+        ext      = ext,
+        renaming = renaming,
+        target   = target,
+        xmlFile  = xmlFile,
+        outFile  = outFile
+      )
+
+    if jobs.isEmpty then return
+
+    val idxOpt =
+      if jobs.forall(_.mode == SOURCE_WORK_DIR) then None
+      else
+        val metaFile = config.metadataDir / METADATA_FILE
+        if !os.exists(metaFile) then
+          Log.pipeline.info("  [MapClones] metadata.json.zst not found -- skipping IR mapping")
+          None
+        else Some(buildIndex(loadMetadata(metaFile)))
+
+    runParallel("MapClones", jobs): (mode, ext, renaming, target, xmlFile, outFile) =>
+      if os.exists(outFile) then
+        Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Cache] MapClones $mode/$renaming/$target -- skipping")
+      else if mode == SOURCE_WORK_DIR then
+        mapTargetSource(renaming, target, xmlFile, outFile)
+      else
+        idxOpt match
+          case Some(idx) => mapTargetIr(mode, ext, renaming, target, xmlFile, idx, outFile)
+          case None      =>
+            Log.pipeline.info(s"  [MapClones] Skipping $mode/$renaming/$target -- no metadata")
+
+  private def loadMetadata(path: os.Path) =
+    path.readZstd(in =>
+      upickle.default.read[Map[String, Map[String, MethodMetadata]]](in.readAllBytes())
+    )
+
+  private def buildIndex(meta: Map[String, Map[String, MethodMetadata]]): Idx =
+    for
+      (target, entries) <- meta
+      m                 <- entries.values
+      prefix = m.relPath.stripPrefix(s"$target/") + "/" + m.classSimpleName
+      (ext, s, e)       <- Seq(
+        (JIMPLE_EXT, m.jnormSootStartLine, m.jnormSootEndLine),
+        (JIMPLE_EXT, m.jnormSootAggStartLine, m.jnormSootAggEndLine),
+        (JIMPLE_EXT, m.jnormSootUpStartLine, m.jnormSootUpEndLine),
+        (JIMPLE_EXT, m.jnormSootUpAggStartLine, m.jnormSootUpAggEndLine),
+        (TAC_EXT, m.onormStartLine, m.onormEndLine),
+        (TAC_EXT, m.onormAggStartLine, m.onormAggEndLine)
+      ).collect { case (x, Some(s), Some(e)) => (x, s, e) }
+    yield (target, prefix, ext, s, e) -> m
+
+  private def mapTargetIr(
+      mode: String,
+      ext: String,
+      renaming: String,
+      target: String,
+      xmlFile: os.Path,
+      idx: Idx,
+      outFile: os.Path
+  ): Unit =
+    writeDedupedCsv(
+      s"mapcl-$mode-$renaming-$target-",
+      xmlFile,
+      outFile,
+      s"$mode/$renaming/$target"
+    ): (f1, s1, e1, f2, s2, e2) =>
+      for
+        m1 <- lookupIr(f1, s1, e1, ext, target, idx)
+        m2 <- lookupIr(f2, s2, e2, ext, target, idx)
+      yield (irHalf(m1), irHalf(m2))
+
+  private def mapTargetSource(
+      renaming: String,
+      target: String,
+      xmlFile: os.Path,
+      outFile: os.Path
+  ): Unit =
+    writeDedupedCsv(
+      s"mapcl-source-$renaming-$target-",
+      xmlFile,
+      outFile,
+      s"source/$renaming/$target"
+    ): (f1, s1, e1, f2, s2, e2) =>
+      for
+        (cat1, name1) <- sourceCoords(f1)
+        (cat2, name2) <- sourceCoords(f2)
+      yield (s"$cat1,$name1,$s1,$e1", s"$cat2,$name2,$s2,$e2")
+
+  // Writes all matched pairs (including duplicates) to a temp file with canonical row ordering
+  // (smaller half first), then delegates deduplication to sort -u. This avoids any in-memory
+  // seen-set regardless of pair count.
+  private def writeDedupedCsv(
+      tmpPrefix: String,
+      xmlFile: os.Path,
+      outFile: os.Path,
+      label: String
+  )(toHalves: (String, Int, Int, String, Int, Int) => Option[(String, String)]): Unit =
+    val tmp = java.io.File.createTempFile(tmpPrefix, ".csv")
+    tmp.deleteOnExit()
+    try
+      val writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(tmp)))
+      try
+        xmlFile.readZstd: in =>
+          streamClones(in): (f1, s1, e1, f2, s2, e2) =>
+            toHalves(f1, s1, e1, f2, s2, e2).foreach: (h1, h2) =>
+              if h1 <= h2 then writer.println(s"$h1,$h2")
+              else writer.println(s"$h2,$h1")
+      finally writer.close()
+      os.makeDir.all(outFile / os.up)
+      os.proc("sort", "-u", "-S", "1G", s"--parallel=$CPU", os.Path(tmp.toPath), "-o", outFile)
+        .call(env = Map("LC_ALL" -> "C"))
+      val count = os.proc("wc", "-l", outFile).call().out.text().trim.split("\\s+")(0).toLong
+      val msg = s"  [MapClones] $label: $count pairs -> $outFile"
+      Log.pipeline.info(msg)
+      Log.metrics.info(msg)
+    finally
+      val _ = tmp.delete()
+
+  private val saxFactory =
+    val f = SAXParserFactory.newInstance()
+    f.setNamespaceAware(false)
+    f
+
+  // NiCad XML structure: <clones><clone><source file="..." startline="..." endline=""/>x2</clone>...</clones>
+  private def streamClones(in: InputStream)(f: (String, Int, Int, String, Int, Int) => Unit): Unit =
+    val parser = saxFactory.newSAXParser()
+
+    val srcFiles = new Array[String](2)
+    val srcStarts = new Array[Int](2)
+    val srcEnds = new Array[Int](2)
+    var srcCount = 0
+
+    val handler = new DefaultHandler:
+      override def startElement(
+          uri: String,
+          local: String,
+          qName: String,
+          attrs: Attributes
+      ): Unit =
+        qName match
+          case "clone"                  => srcCount = 0
+          case "source" if srcCount < 2 =>
+            val file = attrs.getValue("file")
+            val sl = attrs.getValue("startline")
+            val el = attrs.getValue("endline")
+            if file != null && sl != null && el != null then
+              val s = try sl.toInt
+              catch case _: NumberFormatException => -1
+              val e = try el.toInt
+              catch case _: NumberFormatException => -1
+              if s >= 0 && e >= 0 then
+                srcFiles(srcCount) = file; srcStarts(srcCount) = s; srcEnds(srcCount) = e
+                srcCount += 1
+          case _                        =>
+
+      override def endElement(uri: String, local: String, qName: String): Unit =
+        if qName == "clone" && srcCount == 2 then
+          f(srcFiles(0), srcStarts(0), srcEnds(0), srcFiles(1), srcStarts(1), srcEnds(1))
+
+    parser.parse(in, handler)
+
+  // file = "<mode>/<renaming>/target<x>/<funcId>/<category>/_<id>/<Class>.<ext>"
+  private def lookupIr(
+      file: String,
+      s: Int,
+      e: Int,
+      ext: String,
+      target: String,
+      idx: Idx
+  ): Option[MethodMetadata] =
+    val parts = file.split('/')
+    if parts.length < 4 then return None
+    val prefix = parts.drop(3).mkString("/").stripSuffix(s".$ext")
+    idx.get((target, prefix, ext, s, e))
+
+  // file = "source/<renaming>/targetSource/<funcId>/<category>/<id>.java"
+  private def sourceCoords(file: String) =
+    val parts = file.split('/')
+    if parts.length < 6 then None
+    else Some((parts(4), parts(5)))
+
+  private def irHalf(m: MethodMetadata) =
+    s"${m.bcbSubFolder.toString.toLowerCase},${m.bcbFileName},${m.bcbStartLine},${m.bcbEndLine}"

+package steps
+
+import java.io.{BufferedWriter, FileWriter}
+import java.util.concurrent.Semaphore
+import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
+import scala.collection.mutable
+
+import core.*
+import core.Constants.*
+import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory
+import org.slf4j.MDC
+import org.xml.sax.Attributes
+import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
+
+/** Runs NiCad clone detection per functionality (funcId) across 3 NiCad renamings x (6 IR variants
+  * x 4 targets + 1 source baseline):
+  *   1. Partition each funcId directory into batches of at most MAX_NICAD_FILES; large funcIds
+  *      additionally get cross-batch jobs to ensure complete intra-funcId clone coverage.
+  *   2. For each partition job in parallel, run all 3 renamings sequentially in a shared working
+  *      directory so TXL function extraction is paid only once per job; self-jobs additionally save
+  *      the renamed _functions.xml per funcId to record the exact renamed input used for clone
+  *      detection (verification and reproducibility).
+  *   3. When all jobs for a renaming complete, sort-merge clone pairs with sort -u to deduplicate
+  *      mirrored pairs and ensure reproducible output order; serialize to
+  *      work/nicad/<mode>/<renaming>/<target>/clones.xml.zst.
+  */
+class NiCadStep extends Step:
+
+  override val name = "NiCad Clone Detection"
+
+  private val modeDefs =
+    IR_MODES.map((mode, lang) => (mode, lang, ALL_TARGETS)) :+
+      (SOURCE_WORK_DIR, SOURCE_LANG, List(SOURCE_TARGET))
+
+  // --- Private types -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private case class NicadRun(mode: String, target: String, lang: String, renaming: String)
+
+  private case class PartitionJob(
+      batchA: os.Path,
+      batchB: Option[os.Path],
+      funcIdDir: os.Path
+  )
+
+  private case class FuncIdJobs(jobs: Seq[PartitionJob], scratchDir: Option[os.Path])
+
+  private case class GroupState(
+      run: NicadRun,
+      tempWriter: BufferedWriter,
+      tempPath: os.Path,
+      tempLock: Semaphore,
+      remaining: AtomicInteger,
+      scratchRemaining: AtomicInteger,
+      funcIdGroups: Seq[FuncIdJobs],
+      outPath: os.Path,
+      funcIdCount: Int
+  )
+
+  // --- Partitioner -------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private object Partitioner:
+
+    def jobs(funcIdDir: os.Path, lang: String): FuncIdJobs =
+      val ext = lang match
+        case SOURCE_LANG | JIMPLE_EXT => lang
+        case _                        => TAC_EXT
+      val catDirs = funcIdDir.categorySubDirs
+      val files =
+        (if lang == SOURCE_LANG then
+           for
+             categoryDir <- catDirs
+             file        <- os.list(categoryDir).filter(_.ext == ext)
+           yield file
+         else
+           for
+             categoryDir <- catDirs
+             fragmentDir <- categoryDir.fragmentSubDirs

+              i <- batchDirs.indices

+        override def startElement(

+              val el = attrs.getValue("endline")

+    private def findClonePairsXml(cwd: os.Path, renaming: String): Option[os.Path] =

+            .flatMap(clonesDir => os.list(clonesDir))

+    // Indexes each <source> block's byte range and sort key, sorts by (file, startLine),
+    // then copies blocks to the zstd output in sorted order without loading content into memory.
+    private def saveRenamedXmlSorted(src: os.Path, dest: os.Path): Unit =
+      case class Block(file: String, startLine: Int, from: Long, until: Long)
+      val blocks = mutable.ArrayBuffer[Block]()

+      var footerFrom = -1L

+        var inBlock = false
+        var file = ""
+        var startLine = 0
+        var raw = raf.readLine()
+        while raw != null do
+          val next = raf.getFilePointer
+          if raw.startsWith("<source ") then
+            if headerUntil == 0L then headerUntil = pos
+            blockFrom                             = pos; inBlock = true
+            val fs = raw.indexOf("file=\"") + 6; val fe = raw.indexOf('"', fs)
+            file                                  = if fs > 5 then raw.substring(fs, fe) else ""
+            val ss = raw.indexOf("startline=\"") + 11; val se = raw.indexOf('"', ss)
+            startLine = if ss > 10 then raw.substring(ss, se).toIntOption.getOrElse(0) else 0
+          else if raw.trim == "</source>" && inBlock then
+            blocks += Block(file, startLine, blockFrom, next); inBlock = false
+          else if raw.startsWith("</system>") && footerFrom < 0 then
+            footerFrom = pos
+          pos = next
+          raw = raf.readLine()
+        val fileLen = raf.length()
+        val footerStart = if footerFrom >= 0 then footerFrom else fileLen
+        blocks.sortInPlaceBy(b => (b.file, b.startLine))
+        val buf = new Array[Byte](65536)
+        def copy(from: Long, until: Long, out: java.io.OutputStream): Unit =
+          raf.seek(from); var rem = until - from
+          while rem > 0 do
+            val n = raf.read(buf, 0, math.min(buf.length, rem).toInt)
+            if n > 0 then out.write(buf, 0, n)
+            rem -= n
+        dest.writeZstd: out =>
+          if blocks.isEmpty then copy(0L, fileLen, out)
+          else
+            copy(0L, headerUntil, out)
+            blocks.foreach(b => copy(b.from, b.until, out))
+            copy(footerStart, fileLen, out)
+      finally
+        raf.close()
+
+    def writeClonePairsXml(sortedPath: os.Path, outPath: os.Path): Long =
+      os.makeDir.all(outPath / os.up)
+      var count = 0L
+      outPath.writeZstd: out =>
+        out.write("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<clonepairs>\n".getBytes("UTF-8"))
+        os.read.lines.stream(sortedPath).foreach: line =>
+          count += 1
+          writeLine(out, line)
+        out.write("</clonepairs>".getBytes("UTF-8"))
+      count
+
+    private def writeLine(out: java.io.OutputStream, line: String): Unit =
+      out.write((line + "\n").getBytes("UTF-8"))
+
+  // --- Process -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+  override def process(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val activeTargets =
+      for
+        (mode, lang, targets) <- modeDefs
+        irDir = config.workDir / mode
+        target                <- targets
+        irTargetDir = irDir / target

+    if activeTargets.isEmpty then

+    val allJobs = activeTargets.flatMap: (mode, lang, irTargetDir, target) =>
+      val (cached, active) = NICAD_ALL_RENAMINGS.partition: renaming =>
+        os.exists(config.nicadDir / mode / renaming / target / NICAD_CLONES_FILE)

+            val tempFile = java.io.File.createTempFile(s"nicad-$mode-$renaming-$target-", ".tmp")

+              tempWriter       = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(tempFile, true)),

+              tempLock         = new Semaphore(1),
+              remaining        = new AtomicInteger(jobs.size),

+package io.github.lukawnb
+package steps
+
+import core.*
+import core.Constants.*
+import core.utils.CrossVersionMapper.buildCrossTarget
+import onorm.ONorm
+
+/** Runs ONorm in standard and aggressive modes over compiled class files:
+  *   1. For each variant in sequence, run ONorm in parallel per fragment folder across all compile
+  *      targets; one invocation per _<id> prevents OPAL from resolving identically named classes
+  *      under the first occurrence's namespace (OPAL warns; common in IJaDataset2.0).
+  *   2. Build targetCross from the normalized output.
+  */
+class ONormStep extends Step:
+
+  override val name = "ONorm IR (std/agg)"
+
+  override def process(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    runVariant(config.workDir / ONORM_WORK_DIR, aggressive     = false)
+    runVariant(config.workDir / ONORM_AGG_WORK_DIR, aggressive = true)
+
+  private def runVariant(outDir: os.Path, aggressive: Boolean)(using config: RunConfig): Unit =
+    val label = outDir.last
+    val variantStart = System.currentTimeMillis()
+
+    if config.isIncomplete(outDir) then
+      Log.pipeline.info(
+        s"  [ONorm] Running $label for ${COMPILE_TARGETS.mkString(", ")} + cross-version dataset"
+      )
+      os.remove.all(outDir)
+      os.makeDir.all(outDir)
+
+      val allJobs = COMPILE_TARGETS.flatMap: t =>
+        val inputDir = config.compileDir / t
+        if !os.exists(inputDir) then
+          Log.pipeline.warn(s"  [Warn] No compiled source for $t, skipping")
+          Seq.empty
+        else
+          inputDir.funcIdSubDirs
+            .flatMap: funcDir =>
+              funcDir.categorySubDirs
+                .flatMap: categoryDir =>
+                  categoryDir.fragmentSubDirs
+                    .map(fragmentDir =>
+                      (target = t, inputDir = inputDir, fragmentDir = fragmentDir)
+                    )
+
+      Log.pipeline.info(
+        s"  [ONorm] ${allJobs.size} fragment folders across ${COMPILE_TARGETS.mkString(", ")}..."
+      )
+
+      runParallel(s"ONorm $label", allJobs): (target, inputDir, fragmentDir) =>
+        val relPath = fragmentDir.relativeTo(inputDir)
+        val methodOutDir = outDir / target / (relPath / os.up)
+        try ONorm.run(fragmentDir, methodOutDir, aggressive)
+        catch
+          case e: Exception =>
+            Log.pipeline.error(s"  [Error] ONorm $label $target/$relPath: ${e.getMessage}")
+
+      buildCrossTarget(outDir, TAC_EXT)
+
+      val variantDuration = formatDuration(System.currentTimeMillis() - variantStart)
+      val doneMsg = s"  [Done] $label in $variantDuration"
+      Log.pipeline.info(doneMsg)
+      Log.metrics.info(doneMsg)
+      Log.metrics.info(s"ONORM_VARIANT\t$label\t$variantDuration")
+    else
+      Log.pipeline.info(s"  [Cache] All $label targets exist, skipping.")
